   44: function getProductDrawingPreviewUrl(slug: string, configuredUrl?: string) {
   45:   const normalizedConfiguredUrl = configuredUrl?.trim();
   46: 
   47:   if (normalizedConfiguredUrl) {
   48:     return normalizedConfiguredUrl.includes("#")
   49:       ? normalizedConfiguredUrl
   50:       : normalizedConfiguredUrl + "#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1";
   51:   }
   52: 
   53:   const normalizedSlug = slug.trim().toLowerCase();
   54:   const match = normalizedSlug.match(/^(ea|sm|tm)-(\d+)/);
   55: 
   56:   if (!match) {
   57:     return "";
   58:   }
   59: 
   60:   const seriesCode = match[1];
   61:   const seriesUpper = seriesCode.toUpperCase();
   62:   const capacityCode = String(Number(match[2])).padStart(4, "0") + "UL";
   63: 
   64:   return (
   65:     "/assets/products/" +
   66:     seriesCode +
   67:     "/2d-drawings/" +
   68:     seriesUpper +
   69:     "-" +
   70:     capacityCode +
   71:     ".pdf#toolbar=0&navpanes=0&scrollbar=1"
   72:   );
   73: }

  622: function localizeInternalHref(value: unknown, isEnglish: boolean): string {
  623:   const href = String(value || "").trim();
  624: 
  625:   if (
  626:     !isEnglish ||
  627:     !href.startsWith("/") ||
  628:     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
  629:     href === "/en" ||
  630:     href.startsWith("/assets/") ||
  631:     href.startsWith("/images/") ||
  632:     href.startsWith("/_next/") ||
  633:     href.startsWith("/api/")
  634:   ) {
  635:     return href;
  636:   }
  637: 
  638:   return `/en${href}`;
  639: }

  675: 
  676: const PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN = "https://www.foreachtek.com";
  677: 
  678: function toAbsoluteProductUrl(value: unknown) {
  679:   const text = String(value || "").trim();
  680: 
  681:   if (!text) {
  682:     return "";
  683:   }
  684: 
  685:   if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(text)) {
  686:     return text;
  687:   }
  688: 
  689:   return `${PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN}${text.startsWith("/") ? text : `/${text}`}`;
  690: }
  691: 
  692: function collectProductImageUrls(data: any) {
  693:   const values: unknown[] = [
  694:     data.mainImage,
  695:     data.imageUrl,
  696:     data.image,
  697:     data.heroImage,
  698:     data.coverImage,
  699:     ...(Array.isArray(data.images) ? data.images : []),
  700:     ...(Array.isArray(data.galleryImages) ? data.galleryImages : []),
  701:   ];
  702: 
  703:   const urls = values
  704:     .flatMap((value) => {
  705:       if (typeof value === "string") {
  706:         return [value];
  707:       }
  708: 
  709:       if (value && typeof value === "object") {
  710:         const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  711:         return [item.src, item.url, item.path, item.fullPath];
  712:       }
  713: 
  714:       return [];
  715:     })
  716:     .map(toAbsoluteProductUrl)
  717:     .filter(Boolean);
  718: 
  719:   return Array.from(new Set(urls));
  720: }
  721: 
  722: function collectProductSpecifications(data: any) {
  723:   const source = Array.isArray(data.specs)
  724:     ? data.specs
  725:     : Array.isArray(data.specificationGroups)
  726:       ? data.specificationGroups
  727:       : [];
  728:   const rows: Array<{ name: string; value: string }> = [];
  729: 
  730:   function visit(value: unknown) {
  731:     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  732:       value.forEach(visit);
  733:       return;
  734:     }
  735: 
  736:     if (!value || typeof value !== "object") {
  737:       return;
  738:     }
  739: 
  740:     const item = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  741:     const name = String(
  742:       item.label || item.name || item.title || ""
  743:     ).trim();
  744:     const itemValue = String(
  745:       item.value || item.content || item.text || ""
  746:     ).trim();
  747: 
  748:     if (name && itemValue) {
  749:       rows.push({ name, value: itemValue });
  750:     }
  751: 
  752:     Object.entries(item).forEach(([key, child]) => {
  753:       if (!["label", "name", "title", "value", "content", "text"].includes(key)) {
  754:         visit(child);
  755:       }
  756:     });
  757:   }
  758: 
  759:   visit(source);
  760: 
  761:   return Array.from(
  762:     new Map(rows.map((row) => [`${row.name}::${row.value}`, row])).values()
  763:   );
  764: }
  765: 
  766: function buildProductStructuredData(data: any, pathname: string) {
  767:   const canonicalUrl = toAbsoluteProductUrl(pathname || "/");
  768:   const productName = String(
  769:     data.model || data.title || data.name || ""
  770:   ).trim();
  771:   const description = String(data.description || "").trim();
  772:   const imageUrls = collectProductImageUrls(data);
  773:   const applications = Array.isArray(data.commonApplications)
  774:     ? data.commonApplications.filter(Boolean).map(String)
  775:     : [];
  776:   const specifications = collectProductSpecifications(data);
  777:   const faqs: Array<{ question: string; answer: string }> = Array.isArray(data.faqs)
  778:     ? data.faqs
  779:         .map((item: any) => ({
  780:           question: String(item?.question || "").trim(),
  781:           answer: String(item?.answer || "").trim(),
  782:         }))
  783:         .filter((item: { question: string; answer: string }) =>
  784:           item.question && item.answer
  785:         )
  786:     : [];
  787:   const category = String(
  788:     data.categoryLabel || data.productTypeName || ""
  789:   ).trim();
  790: 
  791:   const product: Record<string, unknown> = {
  792:     "@type": "Product",
  793:     "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#product`,
  794:     name: productName,
  795:     url: canonicalUrl,
  796:     description,
  797:     brand: {
  798:       "@type": "Brand",
  799:       name: "FOREACH",
  800:     },
  801:     manufacturer: {
  802:       "@type": "Organization",
  803:       name: "Shenzhen FOREACH Technology Co., Ltd.",
  804:       url: PRODUCT_SITE_ORIGIN,
  805:     },
  806:   };
  807: 
  808:   if (data.productCode || data.seriesCode) {
  809:     product.sku = String(data.productCode || data.seriesCode);
  810:   }
  811: 
  812:   if (category) {
  813:     product.category = category;
  814:   }
  815: 
  816:   if (imageUrls.length > 0) {
  817:     product.image = imageUrls;
  818:   }
  819: 
  820:   if (specifications.length > 0) {
  821:     product.additionalProperty = specifications.map((item) => ({
  822:       "@type": "PropertyValue",
  823:       name: item.name,
  824:       value: item.value,
  825:     }));
  826:   }
  827: 
  828:   const graph: Record<string, unknown>[] = [
  829:     product,
  830:     {
  831:       "@type": "BreadcrumbList",
  832:       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#breadcrumb`,
  833:       itemListElement: [
  834:         {
  835:           "@type": "ListItem",
  836:           position: 1,
  837:           name: "Home",
  838:           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/"),
  839:         },
  840:         {
  841:           "@type": "ListItem",
  842:           position: 2,
  843:           name: "Products",
  844:           item: toAbsoluteProductUrl("/en/products/"),
  845:         },
  846:         {
  847:           "@type": "ListItem",
  848:           position: 3,
  849:           name: productName,
  850:           item: canonicalUrl,
  851:         },
  852:       ],
  853:     },
  854:   ];
  855: 
  856:   if (faqs.length > 0) {
  857:     graph.push({
  858:       "@type": "FAQPage",
  859:       "@id": `${canonicalUrl}#faq`,
  860:       mainEntity: faqs.map((item) => ({
  861:         "@type": "Question",
  862:         name: item.question,
  863:         acceptedAnswer: {
  864:           "@type": "Answer",
  865:           text: item.answer,
  866:         },
  867:       })),
  868:     });
  869:   }
  870: 
  871:   if (applications.length > 0) {
  872:     product.keywords = applications.join(", ");
  873:   }
  874: 
  875:   return {
  876:     "@context": "https://schema.org",
  877:     "@graph": graph,
  878:   };
  879: }

 1034:   function handleMainImageMove(event: MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) {

 1038:     const y = ((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100;

   40: function formatCompatibleModelsForCard(models: string[]) {
   41:   if (models.length === 0) return "-";
   42:

   44:   const suffix = models.length > 3 ? ` +${models.length - 3}` : "";
   45: 
   46:   return `${firstModels.join(" / ")}${suffix}`;

   49: function getLocaleFromBreadcrumbs(
   50:   breadcrumbs: FittingReplacementPageData["breadcrumbs"]

   52:   const href = breadcrumbs.find((item) => {
   53:     return /^\/(en|es|fr|ko|ru)(\/|$)/.test(item.href ?? "");
   54:   })?.href;

   56:   return href?.split("/")[1] ?? "zh";

   59: function findProductsByCompatibleModel(
   60:   products: FittingReplacementProduct[],

  417:           </div>
  418:         </section>
  419:       </main>
  420:     </div>
  421:   );

  225: function containsHan(value: string): boolean {
  226:   return /[\u3400-\u9fff]/.test(value);
  227: }
  228: 
  229: function getPathLabel(href: string): string {
  230:   const segment = href
  231:     .split(/[?#]/)[0]
  232:     .split("/")
  233:     .filter(Boolean)
  234:     .at(-1);
  235: 
  236:   if (!segment) {
  237:     return "FOREACH";
  238:   }
  239: 
  240:   return decodeURIComponent(segment)
  241:     .split(/[-_]+/)
  242:     .filter(Boolean)
  243:     .map((word) =>
  244:       /^[a-z]+$/.test(word)
  245:         ? word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)
  246:         : word.toUpperCase()
  247:     )
  248:     .join(" ");
  249: }

  251: function getTechnicalText(value: string | undefined): string {
  252:   return (value ?? "")
  253:     .replace(/[\u3400-\u9fff：]/g, "")
  254:     .replace(/^\s*[:：-]\s*/, "")
  255:     .trim();
  256: }

  258: function getEnglishSearchItem(item: CompactSearchItem): CompactSearchItem {
  259:   const technicalText = getTechnicalText(item.s);
  260:   const title = !containsHan(item.t)
  261:     ? item.t
  262:     : technicalText || getPathLabel(item.h);
  263:   const subtitle = item.s && !containsHan(item.s)
  264:     ? item.s
  265:     : undefined;
  266:   const pathKeywords = item.h
  267:     .split(/[/?#_-]+/)
  268:     .filter(Boolean)
  269:     .join(" ");

  272:     ...item,

  274:     s: subtitle,
  275:     d: ENGLISH_RESULT_DESCRIPTIONS[item.m],
  276:     a: MODULE_TEXT_EN[item.m].action,
  277:     x: [
  278:       item.x,
  279:       normalize(title),
  280:       normalize(pathKeywords),
  281:       normalize(MODULE_TEXT_EN[item.m].title),
  282:     ].join(" "),
  283:   };
  284: }

  286: function normalize(value: string): string {
  287:   return value
  288:     .trim()
  289:     .toUpperCase()
  290:     .replace(/[‐‑‒–—―﹘﹣－]/g, "-")
  291:     .replace(/\s+/g, "");
  292: }

  294: function isSearchQueryLongEnough(value: string): boolean {
  295:   const normalizedValue = normalize(value);
  296: 
  297:   if (!normalizedValue) return false;
  298: 
  299:   const containsChinese =
  300:     /[\u3400-\u9fff]/.test(normalizedValue);
  301: 
  302:   return containsChinese || normalizedValue.length >= 2;
  303: }

  305: function useDebouncedValue(
  306:   value: string,
  307:   delay: number
  308: ): string {
  309:   const [debouncedValue, setDebouncedValue] =
  310:     useState(value);
  311: 
  312:   useEffect(() => {
  313:     const timer = window.setTimeout(() => {
  314:       setDebouncedValue(value);
  315:     }, delay);
  316: 
  317:     return () => {
  318:       window.clearTimeout(timer);
  319:     };
  320:   }, [delay, value]);
  321: 
  322:   return debouncedValue;
  323: }

  325: function scoreItem(
  326:   item: CompactSearchItem,
  327:   normalizedQuery: string
  328: ): number {
  329:   if (
  330:     !normalizedQuery ||
  331:     !item.x.includes(normalizedQuery)
  332:   ) {
  333:     return 0;
  334:   }
  335: 
  336:   const title = normalize(item.t);
  337:   const subtitle = normalize(item.s ?? "");
  338: 
  339:   let score = 30;
  340: 
  341:   if (title === normalizedQuery) score += 1200;
  342: 
  343:   if (
  344:     item.m === "compatible-models" &&
  345:     title === normalizedQuery
  346:   ) {
  347:     score += 700;
  348:   }
  349: 
  350:   if (title.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) {
  351:     score += 600;
  352:   } else if (title.includes(normalizedQuery)) {
  353:     score += 330;
  354:   }
  355: 
  356:   if (subtitle === normalizedQuery) {
  357:     score += 500;
  358:   } else if (subtitle.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) {
  359:     score += 260;
  360:   } else if (subtitle.includes(normalizedQuery)) {
  361:     score += 150;
  362:   }
  363: 
  364:   return score;
  365: }

  367: function escapeRegExp(value: string): string {
  368:   return value.replace(
  369:     /[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g,
  370:     "\\$&"
  371:   );
  372: }

  374: function highlightText(
  375:   value: string,
  376:   query: string
  377: ): ReactNode {
  378:   const keyword = query.trim();
  379: 
  380:   if (!keyword) return value;
  381: 
  382:   const parts = value.split(
  383:     new RegExp(
  384:       `(${escapeRegExp(keyword)})`,
  385:       "ig"
  386:     )
  387:   );
  388: 
  389:   return parts.map((part, index) => {
  390:     if (
  391:       part.toLowerCase() ===
  392:       keyword.toLowerCase()
  393:     ) {
  394:       return (
  395:         <mark key={`${part}-${index}`}>
  396:           {part}
  397:         </mark>
  398:       );
  399:     }
  400: 
  401:     return (
  402:       <Fragment key={`${part}-${index}`}>
  403:         {part}
  404:       </Fragment>
  405:     );
  406:   });
  407: }

  409: function getLocalizedHref(
  410:   href: string,
  411:   locale: string
  412: ): string {
  413:   if (
  414:     !href.startsWith("/") ||
  415:     href.startsWith("/downloads/") ||
  416:     locale === "zh-CN" ||
  417:     locale === "zh"
  418:   ) {
  419:     return href;
  420:   }
  421: 
  422:   const firstSegment = href
  423:     .split("/")
  424:     .filter(Boolean)[0];
  425: 
  426:   if (
  427:     ["en", "es", "fr", "ko", "ru"].includes(
  428:       firstSegment ?? ""
  429:     )
  430:   ) {
  431:     return href;
  432:   }
  433: 
  434:   return `/${locale}${href}`;
  435: }

  437: export default function GlobalSearchPanel({
  438:   isOpen,
  439:   query,
  440:   locale,
  441:   onQueryChange,
  442:   onClose,
  443: }: GlobalSearchPanelProps) {
  444:   const isEnglish = locale === "en";
  445:   const moduleText = isEnglish
  446:     ? MODULE_TEXT_EN
  447:     : MODULE_TEXT;
  448:   const suggestions = isEnglish
  449:     ? INITIAL_SUGGESTIONS_EN
  450:     : INITIAL_SUGGESTIONS;
  451: 
  452:   const debouncedQuery = useDebouncedValue(
  453:     query,
  454:     SEARCH_DEBOUNCE_MS
  455:   );
  456: 
  457:   const [items, setItems] =
  458:     useState<CompactSearchItem[] | null>(
  459:       cachedSearchItems
  460:     );
  461: 
  462:   const [loadState, setLoadState] = useState<
  463:     "idle" | "loading" | "ready" | "error"
  464:   >(cachedSearchItems ? "ready" : "idle");
  465: 
  466:   const [headerBottom, setHeaderBottom] =
  467:     useState(84);
  468: 
  469:   const [visibleCounts, setVisibleCounts] =
  470:     useState<
  471:       Partial<Record<SearchModule, number>>
  472:     >({});
  473: 
  474:   useEffect(() => {
  475:     if (cachedSearchItems) {
  476:       setItems(cachedSearchItems);
  477:       setLoadState("ready");
  478:       return;
  479:     }
  480: 
  481:     const idleWindow = window as IdleWindow;
  482:     let idleId: number | undefined;
  483:     let fallbackTimer: number | undefined;
  484:     let cancelled = false;
  485: 
  486:     const preload = () => {
  487:       void preloadGlobalSearchIndex()
  488:         .then((loadedItems) => {
  489:           if (cancelled) return;
  490: 
  491:           setItems(loadedItems);
  492:           setLoadState("ready");
  493:         })
  494:         .catch(() => {
  495:           // 正式打开搜索时会再次尝试。
  496:         });
  497:     };
  498: 
  499:     if (idleWindow.requestIdleCallback) {
  500:       idleId = idleWindow.requestIdleCallback(
  501:         preload,
  502:         { timeout: 1600 }
  503:       );
  504:     } else {
  505:       fallbackTimer = window.setTimeout(
  506:         preload,
  507:         600
  508:       );
  509:     }
  510: 
  511:     return () => {
  512:       cancelled = true;
  513: 
  514:       if (
  515:         idleId !== undefined &&
  516:         idleWindow.cancelIdleCallback
  517:       ) {
  518:         idleWindow.cancelIdleCallback(idleId);
  519:       }
  520: 
  521:       if (fallbackTimer !== undefined) {
  522:         window.clearTimeout(fallbackTimer);
  523:       }
  524:     };
  525:   }, []);
  526: 
  527:   useEffect(() => {
  528:     if (!isOpen || items) return;
  529: 
  530:     let cancelled = false;
  531: 
  532:     setLoadState("loading");
  533: 
  534:     void preloadGlobalSearchIndex()
  535:       .then((loadedItems) => {
  536:         if (cancelled) return;
  537: 
  538:         setItems(loadedItems);
  539:         setLoadState("ready");
  540:       })
  541:       .catch(() => {
  542:         if (cancelled) return;
  543: 
  544:         setLoadState("error");
  545:       });
  546: 
  547:     return () => {
  548:       cancelled = true;
  549:     };
  550:   }, [isOpen, items]);
  551: 
  552:   useEffect(() => {
  553:     if (!isOpen) return;
  554: 
  555:     function updateHeaderBottom() {
  556:       const header =
  557:         document.querySelector(".site-header");
  558: 
  559:       const nextBottom =
  560:         header?.getBoundingClientRect().bottom ??
  561:         84;
  562: 
  563:       setHeaderBottom(
  564:         Math.max(0, nextBottom)
  565:       );
  566:     }
  567: 
  568:     updateHeaderBottom();
  569: 
  570:     window.addEventListener(
  571:       "resize",
  572:       updateHeaderBottom
  573:     );
  574: 
  575:     window.addEventListener(
  576:       "scroll",
  577:       updateHeaderBottom,
  578:       { passive: true }
  579:     );
  580: 
  581:     document.body.classList.add(
  582:       "global-search-lock"
  583:     );
  584: 
  585:     return () => {
  586:       window.removeEventListener(
  587:         "resize",
  588:         updateHeaderBottom
  589:       );
  590: 
  591:       window.removeEventListener(
  592:         "scroll",
  593:         updateHeaderBottom
  594:       );
  595: 
  596:       document.body.classList.remove(
  597:         "global-search-lock"
  598:       );
  599:     };
  600:   }, [isOpen]);
  601: 
  602:   useEffect(() => {
  603:     setVisibleCounts({});
  604:   }, [debouncedQuery]);
  605: 
  606:   const queryIsLongEnough =
  607:     isSearchQueryLongEnough(debouncedQuery);
  608: 
  609:   const displayItems = useMemo(() => {
  610:     if (!items || !isEnglish) {
  611:       return items;
  612:     }
  613: 
  614:     return items.map(getEnglishSearchItem);
  615:   }, [isEnglish, items]);
  616: 
  617:   const groupedResults = useMemo(() => {
  618:     const grouped = new Map<
  619:       SearchModule,
  620:       ScoredItem[]
  621:     >();
  622: 
  623:     for (const moduleId of MODULE_ORDER) {
  624:       grouped.set(moduleId, []);
  625:     }
  626: 
  627:     const normalizedQuery =
  628:       normalize(debouncedQuery);
  629: 
  630:     if (
  631:       !normalizedQuery ||
  632:       !queryIsLongEnough ||
  633:       !displayItems
  634:     ) {
  635:       return grouped;
  636:     }
  637: 
  638:     for (const item of displayItems) {
  639:       const score = scoreItem(
  640:         item,
  641:         normalizedQuery
  642:       );
  643: 
  644:       if (score <= 0) continue;
  645: 
  646:       grouped.get(item.m)?.push({
  647:         item,
  648:         score,
  649:       });
  650:     }
  651: 
  652:     for (const moduleId of MODULE_ORDER) {
  653:       const moduleItems =
  654:         grouped.get(moduleId) ?? [];
  655: 
  656:       moduleItems.sort((a, b) => {
  657:         return (
  658:           b.score - a.score ||
  659:           a.item.t.localeCompare(
  660:             b.item.t,
  661:             "zh-CN"
  662:           )
  663:         );
  664:       });
  665: 
  666:       grouped.set(moduleId, moduleItems);
  667:     }
  668: 
  669:     return grouped;
  670:   }, [
  671:     debouncedQuery,
  672:     displayItems,
  673:     queryIsLongEnough,
  674:   ]);
  675: 
  676:   const visibleModules = MODULE_ORDER.filter(
  677:     (module) => {
  678:       return (
  679:         groupedResults.get(module)?.length ?? 0
  680:       ) > 0;
  681:     }
  682:   );
  683: 
  684:   const totalCount = visibleModules.reduce(
  685:     (sum, module) => {
  686:       return (
  687:         sum +
  688:         (groupedResults.get(module)?.length ?? 0)
  689:       );
  690:     },
  691:     0
  692:   );
  693: 
  694:   if (!isOpen || typeof document === "undefined") {
  695:     return null;
  696:   }
  697: 
  698:   const isWaitingForDebounce =
  699:     query.trim() !== debouncedQuery.trim();
  700: 
  701:   const showLoading =
  702:     Boolean(query.trim()) &&
  703:     (
  704:       isWaitingForDebounce ||
  705:       loadState === "loading" ||
  706:       (!items && loadState !== "error")
  707:     );
  708: 
  709:   const queryTooShort =
  710:     Boolean(debouncedQuery.trim()) &&
  711:     !queryIsLongEnough;
  712: 
  713:   return createPortal(
  714:     <section
  715:       className="global-search-panel"
  716:       data-global-search-panel="true"
  717:       aria-label={
  718:         isEnglish
  719:           ? "Site search results"
  720:           : "全站搜索结果"
  721:       }
  722:       style={{
  723:         top: headerBottom,
  724:       }}
  725:       onPointerDownCapture={(event) => {
  726:         event.stopPropagation();
  727:       }}
  728:       onClick={(event) => {
  729:         event.stopPropagation();
  730:       }}
  731:     >
  732:       <div className="global-search-panel-inner">
  733:         <div className="global-search-panel-head">
  734:           <div>
  735:             <span>{isEnglish ? "Site Search" : "全站搜索"}</span>
  736: 
  737:             <strong>
  738:               {query.trim()
  739:                 ? `“${query.trim()}”`
  740:                 : isEnglish
  741:                   ? "Search products and technical resources"
  742:                   : "搜索产品与技术资料"}
  743:             </strong>
  744:           </div>
  745: 
  746:           <div className="global-search-panel-head-actions">
  747:             {query.trim() &&
  748:             !showLoading &&
  749:             !queryTooShort &&
  750:             loadState === "ready" ? (

   77: function containsHan(value: string): boolean {
   78:   return /[\u3400-\u9fff]/.test(value);
   79: }
   80: 
   81: function getPathLabel(href: string): string {
   82:   const segment = href
   83:     .split(/[?#]/)[0]
   84:     .split("/")
   85:     .filter(Boolean)
   86:     .at(-1);
   87: 
   88:   if (!segment) {
   89:     return "FOREACH";
   90:   }
   91: 
   92:   return decodeURIComponent(segment)
   93:     .split(/[-_]+/)
   94:     .filter(Boolean)
   95:     .map((word) =>
   96:       /^[a-z]+$/.test(word)
   97:         ? word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1)
   98:         : word.toUpperCase()
   99:     )
  100:     .join(" ");
  101: }
  102: 
  103: function getLocalizedResultHref(href: string, locale: string): string {
  104:   if (
  105:     !href.startsWith("/") ||
  106:     href.startsWith("/downloads/") ||
  107:     locale === "zh-CN" ||
  108:     locale === "zh"
  109:   ) {
  110:     return href;
  111:   }
  112: 
  113:   const firstSegment = href.split("/").filter(Boolean)[0];
  114: 
  115:   if (["en", "es", "fr", "ko", "ru"].includes(firstSegment ?? "")) {
  116:     return href;
  117:   }
  118: 
  119:   return `/${locale}${href}`;
  120: }
  121: 
  122: function getEnglishSearchItem(item: SiteSearchItem): SiteSearchItem {
  123:   const title = !containsHan(item.title)
  124:     ? item.title
  125:     : item.model || item.productCode || getPathLabel(item.href);
  126:   const subtitle = item.subtitle && !containsHan(item.subtitle)
  127:     ? item.subtitle
  128:     : item.model && item.model !== title
  129:       ? `Model: ${item.model}`
  130:       : undefined;
  131: 
  132:   return {
  133:     ...item,
  134:     title,
  135:     subtitle,
  136:     description: ENGLISH_RESULT_DESCRIPTIONS[item.module],
  137:     href: getLocalizedResultHref(item.href, "en"),
  138:     actionLabel:
  139:       item.module === "datasheets"
  140:         ? "View Datasheet"
  141:         : item.module === "compatible-models"
  142:           ? "View Compatible Product"
  143:           : "View Product",
  144:     keywords: [
  145:       ...item.keywords,
  146:       title,
  147:       item.href.split(/[/?#_-]+/).join(" "),
  148:       MODULE_TEXT_EN[item.module].title,
  149:     ],
  150:   };
  151: }
  152: 
  153: function normalize(value: string): string {
  154:   return value
  155:     .trim()
  156:     .toUpperCase()
  157:     .replace(/[‐‑‒–—―﹘﹣－]/g, "-")
  158:     .replace(/\s+/g, "");
  159: }
  160: 
  161: function scoreItem(item: SiteSearchItem, query: string): number {
  162:   const normalizedQuery = normalize(query);
  163:   if (!normalizedQuery) return 0;
  164: 
  165:   const title = normalize(item.title);
  166:   const model = normalize(item.model ?? "");
  167:   const productCode = normalize(item.productCode ?? "");
  168:   const keywordValues = item.keywords.map(normalize);
  169: 
  170:   let score = 0;
  171: 
  172:   if (title === normalizedQuery) score += 1000;
  173:   if (model === normalizedQuery) score += 950;
  174:   if (productCode === normalizedQuery) score += 900;
  175: 
  176:   if (title.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) score += 500;
  177:   if (model.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) score += 480;
  178:   if (productCode.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) score += 460;
  179: 
  180:   if (title.includes(normalizedQuery)) score += 250;
  181:   if (model.includes(normalizedQuery)) score += 240;
  182:   if (productCode.includes(normalizedQuery)) score += 230;
  183: 
  184:   for (const keyword of keywordValues) {
  185:     if (keyword === normalizedQuery) score += 180;
  186:     else if (keyword.startsWith(normalizedQuery)) score += 100;
  187:     else if (keyword.includes(normalizedQuery)) score += 50;
  188:   }
  189: 
  190:   return score;
  191: }
  192: 
  193: function getLocalizedSearchPath(locale: string) {
  194:   return locale === "zh-CN" || locale === "zh"
  195:     ? "/search"
  196:     : `/${locale}/search`;
  197: }

  245: export default function SiteSearchClient({

  248:   const router = useRouter();
  249:   const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  250: 
  251:   const queryFromUrl = searchParams.get("q")?.trim() ?? "";
  252:   const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState(queryFromUrl);
  253:   const isEnglish = locale === "en";
  254:   const moduleText = isEnglish ? MODULE_TEXT_EN : MODULE_TEXT;
  255: 
  256:   const groupedResults = useMemo(() => {
  257:     const result: Record<SiteSearchModule, SiteSearchItem[]> = {
  258:       products: [],
  259:       "compatible-models": [],
  260:       datasheets: [],
  261:     };
  262: 
  263:     if (!queryFromUrl) return result;
  264: 
  265:     for (const sourceItem of siteSearchIndex) {
  266:       const item = isEnglish
  267:         ? getEnglishSearchItem(sourceItem)
  268:         : sourceItem;
  269:       const score = scoreItem(item, queryFromUrl);
  270:       if (score <= 0) continue;
  271: 
  272:       result[item.module].push({
  273:         ...item,
  274:         __score: score,
  275:       } as SiteSearchItem & { __score: number });
  276:     }
  277: 
  278:     for (const moduleId of MODULE_ORDER) {
  279:       result[moduleId] = result[moduleId]
  280:         .sort((a, b) => {
  281:           const scoreA = (a as SiteSearchItem & { __score: number }).__score;
  282:           const scoreB = (b as SiteSearchItem & { __score: number }).__score;
  283: 
  284:           return scoreB - scoreA || a.title.localeCompare(b.title, isEnglish ? "en" : "zh-CN");
  285:         })
  286:         .slice(0, 24);
  287:     }
  288: 
  289:     return result;
  290:   }, [isEnglish, queryFromUrl]);
  291: 
  292:   const totalResults = MODULE_ORDER.reduce((sum, module) => {
  293:     return sum + groupedResults[module].length;
  294:   }, 0);
  295:

  301: 
  302:     router.push(
  303:       keyword
  304:         ? `${path}?q=${encodeURIComponent(keyword)}`
  305:         : path
  306:     );
  307:   }
  308: 
  309:   return (

  311:       <section className="site-search-hero">

  314:           <h1>{isEnglish ? "Site Search" : "全站搜索"}</h1>
  315:           <p>
  316:             {isEnglish
  317:               ? "Search products, models, compatible models, and datasheets across the FOREACH website."
  318:               : "搜索产品、型号、兼容型号和规格书，并在对应模块中查看结果。"}
  319:           </p>
  320: 
  321:           <form className="site-search-form" onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
  322:             <input
  323:               type="search"
  324:               value={inputValue}
  325:               placeholder={
  326:                 isEnglish
  327:                   ? "Search products, models, compatible models, or datasheets"
  328:                   : "搜索产品、型号、兼容型号或规格书"
  329:               }
  330:               aria-label={isEnglish ? "Site search" : "全站搜索"}
  331:               onChange={(event) => {
  332:                 setInputValue(event.target.value);
  333:               }}
  334:             />
  335:             <button type="submit">{isEnglish ? "Search" : "搜索"}</button>
  336:           </form>

  348:             </p>

  355:                 <strong>{queryFromUrl}</strong>
  356:               </div>

  373:                 </p>
  374:               </section>

  376:

  379:               const text = moduleText[module];
  380:

  384:                   key={module}
  385:                   id={`search-module-${module}`}
  386:                 >
  387:                   <div className="site-search-module-heading">
  388:                     <div>
  389:                       <h2>{text.title}</h2>
  390:                       <p>{text.description}</p>
  391:                     </div>
  392:                     <span>
  393:                       {isEnglish ? items.length : `${items.length} 条`}
  394:                     </span>
  395:                   </div>
  396:

  398:                     <div className="site-search-result-grid">
  399:                       {items.map((item) => (
  400:                         <SearchResultItem
  401:                           item={item}
  402:                           isEnglish={isEnglish}
  403:                           key={item.id}
  404:                         />
  405:                       ))}
  406:                     </div>
  407:                   ) : (
  408:                     <div className="site-search-module-empty">
  409:                       {text.empty}
  410:                     </div>
  411:                   )}
  412:                 </section>
  413:               );
  414:             })}
  415:           </>
  416:         )}
  417:       </div>
  418:     </main>
  419:   );

   63: function preloadPrintImage(src: string) {
   64:   return new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   65:     if (typeof window === "undefined") {
   66:       resolve();
   67:       return;
   68:     }
   69: 
   70:     const image = new window.Image();
   71: 
   72:     image.onload = () => {
   73:       resolve();
   74:     };
   75: 
   76:     image.onerror = () => {
   77:       resolve();
   78:     };
   79: 
   80:     image.src = src;
   81:   });
   82: }

   90: function getCartDetailHref(
   91:   href: string | undefined,

   94:   if (
   95:     !href ||
   96:     !isEnglish ||
   97:     !href.startsWith("/") ||
   98:     href.startsWith("/en/") ||
   99:     href === "/en"
  100:   ) {
  101:     return href;
  102:   }
  103: 
  104:   return `/en${href}`;
  105: }

  547:                               <strong>{item.productName}</strong>
  548:                             </div>
  549:                           ) : (
  550:                             <>
  551:                               <div className={styles.infoRow}>
  552:                                 <span>{isEnglish ? "Compatible Models" : "兼容编码"}</span>
  553:                                 <strong>
  554:                                   {item.competitorModels.join(" / ") || "-"}
  555:                                 </strong>
  556:                               </div>
  557: 
  558:                               <div className={styles.infoRow}>
  559:                                 <span>{isEnglish ? "Product Code" : "商品编码"}</span>
  560:                                 <strong>{item.productCode}</strong>
  561:                               </div>
  562:                             </>
  563:                           )}
  564: 
  565:                           <div className={styles.quantityRow}>
  566:                             <label htmlFor={`global-cart-qty-${item.id}`}>
  567:                               {isEnglish ? "Quantity" : "数量"}
  568:                             </label>
  569: 
  570:                             <input
  571:                               id={`global-cart-qty-${item.id}`}
  572:                               type="number"
  573:                               min={1}
  574:                               value={item.quantity}
  575:                               onChange={(event) => {
  576:                                 changeQuantity(
  577:                                   item.id,
  578:                                   Number(event.target.value || 1),
  579:                                 );
  580:                               }}
  581:                             />
  582:                           </div>
  583:                         </article>
  584:                       );
  585:                     })}
  586:                   </div>
  587:                 </>
  588:               )}
  589: 
  590:               <div className={styles.note}>
  591:                 <strong>{isEnglish ? "List Notes" : "清单说明"}</strong>
  592:                 <p>
  593:                   {isEnglish
  594:                     ? "Adding a product does not automatically request a drawing. Mark the required models here or on the product page; only marked models will be included in the drawing request."
  595:                     : "产品加入清单后不会默认发送图纸。需要图纸的型号，可在详情页或清单中切换。后续提交需求时，只会把标记“需要图纸”的型号纳入图纸发送范围。"}
  596:                 </p>
  597:               </div>
  598:             </div>
  599: 
  600:             <div className={styles.footer}>
  601:               <button
  602:                 className={styles.requestDrawingButton}
  603:                 type="button"
  604:                 onClick={handleOpenDrawingRequestModal}
  605:               >
  606:                 {isEnglish ? "Request Drawings" : "申请图纸"}
  607:               </button>
  608: 
  609:               <button
  610:                 className={styles.primaryButton}
  611:                 type="button"
  612:                 onClick={handleGeneratePdfList}
  613:               >
  614:                 {isEnglish ? "Generate PDF List" : "生成 PDF 清单"}
  615:               </button>
  616: 
  617:               <button
  618:                 className={styles.secondaryButton}
  619:                 type="button"
  620:                 onClick={copyCartText}
  621:               >
  622:                 {isEnglish ? "Copy List" : "复制分享"}
  623:               </button>
  624: 
  625:               <button
  626:                 className={styles.secondaryButton}
  627:                 type="button"
  628:                 onClick={clearCart}
  629:               >
  630:                 {isEnglish ? "Clear" : "清空"}
  631:               </button>
  632:             </div>
  633:           </aside>
  634:         </>
  635:       )}

  640:       <CompanyInfoRequestModal

  648:         }
  649:         items={drawingRequestModalItems}
  650:         emptyTitle={isEnglish ? "No drawings requested" : "当前还没有图纸需求"}
  651:         emptyDescription={
  652:           isEnglish
  653:             ? "Return to the list and select Add Drawing for each required model before submitting the request."
  654:             : "请先回到清单，在需要图纸的型号旁点击“添加图纸”，再提交图纸申请。"
  655:         }
  656:         submitLabel={isEnglish ? "Submit Drawing Request" : "提交申请图纸"}
  657:         successTitle={isEnglish ? "Drawing Request Submitted" : "图纸申请已提交"}
  658:         successDescription={
  659:           isEnglish
  660:             ? "This is currently a front-end preview. Once the email service is connected, the request will be reviewed and the relevant drawings will be sent after confirmation."
  661:             : "当前为前端视觉模拟。正式上线后，我们会通过邮件接口接收申请，并在确认信息后发送相关图纸资料。"
  662:         }
  663:         enableEmailVerification
  664:         onClose={() => {
  665:           setIsDrawingRequestModalOpen(false);
  666:         }}
  667:         onSubmitPreview={handleSubmitDrawingRequest}
  668:       />
  669:

  674:           避免原网页高度造成多页空白。
  675:       ===================================================== */}
  676:       {isMounted ? createPortal(printDocument, document.body) : null}
  677:     </>
  678:   );
  679: }

    1: /* =========================================================
    2:    selection-cart.types.ts
    3:    恒永达官网｜全局选型清单类型定义
    4: 
    5:    文件路径：
    6:    components/selection-cart/selection-cart.types.ts
    7: 
    8:    作用：
    9:    1. 定义全站统一选型清单的数据结构
   10:    2. 后续接头、泵、阀、传感器等产品都可以加入同一个清单
   11:    3. 当前先服务：接头型号替代查询
   12: ========================================================= */
   13: 
   14: /* 清单来源类型
   15:    说明：
   16:    后续如果增加泵、阀、传感器，可以继续扩展字符串。
   17: */
   18: export type SelectionCartSourceType =
   19:   | "fitting-replacement"
   20:   | "pump-selection"
   21:   | "valve-selection"
   22:   | "sensor-selection"
   23:   | "custom";
   24: 
   25: /* 全局清单单项 */
   26: export interface SelectionCartItem {
   27:   /* 全局唯一 ID，建议格式：sourceType:productCode */
   28:   id: string;
   29: 
   30:   /* 来源模块 */
   31:   sourceType: SelectionCartSourceType;
   32: 
   33:   /* 来源模块中文名称，例如：接头型号替代查询 */
   34:   sourceLabel: string;
   35: 
   36:   /* 产品分类名称，例如：Q20 快插接头 */
   37:   productName: string;
   38: 
   39:   /* 商品编码，例如：839034 */
   40:   productCode: string;
   41: 
   42:   /* 恒永达型号，例如：Q2001-PNV-SACN */
   43:   foreachModel: string;
   44: 
   45:   /* 兼容编码，例如：A0015 / B0004 / C0004 */
   46:   competitorModels: string[];
   47: 
   48:   /* 数量 */
   49:   quantity: number;
   50: 
   51:   /* 是否需要 2D 图纸 */
   52:   needDrawing: boolean;
   53: 
   54:   /* 产品详情页链接 */
   55:   detailHref?: string;
   56: 
   57:   /* 产品图片路径 */
   58:   imagePath?: string;
   59: }
   60: 
   61: /* 加入清单时的输入结构
   62:    说明：
   63:    id 和 quantity 可以自动补齐。
   64: */
   65: export type SelectionCartItemInput = Omit<
   66:   SelectionCartItem,
   67:   "id" | "quantity"
   68: > & {
   69:   id?: string;
   70:   quantity?: number;
   71: };

文件：components\selection-cart\SelectionCartProvider.tsx

    1: "use client";
    2: 
    3: /* =========================================================
    4:    SelectionCartProvider.tsx
    5:    恒永达官网｜全局选型清单状态 Provider
    6: 
    7:    文件路径：
    8:    components/selection-cart/SelectionCartProvider.tsx
    9: 
   10:    作用：
   11:    1. 在全站最高层维护统一选型清单
   12:    2. 首页、详情页、后续产品页都通过 useSelectionCart 使用同一个清单
   13:    3. 清单数据写入 localStorage，刷新页面后仍可保留
   14:    4. 后续统一提交需求、生成资料包、发送邮件都基于这里的数据
   15: ========================================================= */
   16: 
   17: import {
   18:   createContext,
   19:   useContext,
   20:   useEffect,
   21:   useMemo,
   22:   useState,
   23:   type ReactNode,
   24: } from "react";
   25: import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
   26: 
   27: import { getLocaleFromPathname } from "@/lib/i18n";
   28: 
   29: import type {
   30:   SelectionCartItem,
   31:   SelectionCartItemInput,
   32:   SelectionCartSourceType,
   33: } from "./selection-cart.types";
   34: 
   35: /* 新版全局清单缓存 key */
   36: const GLOBAL_CART_STORAGE_KEY = "foreach_global_selection_cart_v1";
   37: 
   38: /* 旧版接头清单缓存 key
   39:    说明：
   40:    用于兼容之前已经写入浏览器的清单数据。
   41: */
   42: const LEGACY_FITTING_CART_STORAGE_KEY = "foreach_fitting_replacement_cart_v1";
   43: 
   44: interface SelectionCartContextValue {
   45:   items: SelectionCartItem[];
   46:   isOpen: boolean;
   47: 
   48:   openCart: () => void;
   49:   closeCart: () => void;
   50: 
   51:   addItem: (item: SelectionCartItemInput) => void;
   52:   removeItem: (id: string) => void;
   53:   clearCart: () => void;
   54: 
   55:   changeQuantity: (id: string, quantity: number) => void;
   56:   toggleDrawingNeed: (id: string, needDrawing: boolean) => void;
   57: 
   58:   getItem: (
   59:     sourceType: SelectionCartSourceType,
   60:     productCode: string
   61:   ) => SelectionCartItem | undefined;
   62: 
   63:   copyCartText: () => Promise<void>;
   64:   generatePdfList: () => void;
   65: 
   66:   printTime: string;
   67: }
   68: 
   69: const SelectionCartContext = createContext<SelectionCartContextValue | null>(
   70:   null
   71: );
   72: 
   73: /* =========================================================
   74:    生成清单项 ID
   75: ========================================================= */
   76: function buildCartItemId(item: {
   77:   sourceType: SelectionCartSourceType;
   78:   productCode: string;
   79: }) {
   80:   return `${item.sourceType}:${item.productCode}`;
   81: }
   82: 
   83: /* =========================================================
   84:    兼容旧版接头清单数据
   85: 
   86:    说明：
   87:    旧版 FittingSelectionCartItem 没有 sourceType、sourceLabel、productName。
   88:    这里做一次兼容转换。
   89: ========================================================= */
   90: function normalizeLegacyFittingItems(rawItems: unknown): SelectionCartItem[] {
   91:   if (!Array.isArray(rawItems)) return [];
   92: 
   93:   return rawItems
   94:     .map((item) => {
   95:       if (!item || typeof item !== "object") return null;
   96: 
   97:       const raw = item as Partial<SelectionCartItem> & {
   98:         productCode?: string;
   99:         foreachModel?: string;
  100:         competitorModels?: string[];
  101:         quantity?: number;
  102:         needDrawing?: boolean;
  103:         imagePath?: string;
  104:       };
  105: 
  106:       if (!raw.productCode || !raw.foreachModel) return null;
  107: 
  108:       const normalizedItem: SelectionCartItem = {
  109:         id: buildCartItemId({
  110:           sourceType: "fitting-replacement",
  111:           productCode: raw.productCode,
  112:         }),
  113:         sourceType: "fitting-replacement",
  114:         sourceLabel: "接头型号替代查询",
  115:         productName: "Q20 快插接头",
  116:         productCode: raw.productCode,
  117:         foreachModel: raw.foreachModel,
  118:         competitorModels: Array.isArray(raw.competitorModels)
  119:           ? raw.competitorModels
  120:           : [],
  121:         quantity: Math.max(1, Number(raw.quantity || 1)),
  122:         needDrawing: Boolean(raw.needDrawing),
  123:         imagePath: raw.imagePath,
  124:         detailHref: `/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/${raw.productCode}`,
  125:       };
  126: 
  127:       return normalizedItem;
  128:     })
  129:     .filter(Boolean) as SelectionCartItem[];
  130: }
  131: 
  132: /* =========================================================
  133:    生成复制文本
  134: ========================================================= */
  135: function buildCartText(
  136:   items: SelectionCartItem[],
  137:   isEnglish: boolean,
  138: ) {
  139:   if (items.length === 0) {
  140:     return isEnglish
  141:       ? "No products selected"
  142:       : "暂无选型产品";
  143:   }
  144: 
  145:   const lines = items.map((item, index) => {
  146:     const isPumpSelection = item.sourceType === "pump-selection";
  147:     const sourceLabel = isEnglish
  148:       ? isPumpSelection
  149:         ? "Products"
  150:         : "Fitting Replacement Search"
  151:       : item.sourceLabel;
  152: 
  153:     if (isPumpSelection) {
  154:       return [
  155:         `#${index + 1}`,
  156:         `${isEnglish ? "Source" : "来源"}: ${sourceLabel}`,
  157:         `${isEnglish ? "Product Type" : "产品类型"}: ${item.productName}`,
  158:         `${isEnglish ? "Product Model" : "产品型号"}: ${item.foreachModel}`,
  159:         `${isEnglish ? "Quantity" : "数量"}: ${item.quantity}`,
  160:         `${isEnglish ? "2D Drawing" : "2D 图纸"}: ${
  161:           item.needDrawing
  162:             ? isEnglish ? "Required" : "需要"
  163:             : isEnglish ? "Not Required" : "暂不需要"
  164:         }`,
  165:       ].join("\n");
  166:     }
  167: 
  168:     return [
  169:       `#${index + 1}`,
  170:       `${isEnglish ? "Source" : "来源"}: ${sourceLabel}`,
  171:       `${isEnglish ? "Product" : "产品"}: ${item.productName}`,
  172:       `${isEnglish ? "Product Code" : "商品编码"}: ${item.productCode}`,
  173:       `${isEnglish ? "FOREACH Model" : "恒永达型号"}: ${item.foreachModel}`,
  174:       `${isEnglish ? "Compatible Models" : "兼容编码"}: ${item.competitorModels.join(" / ") || "-"}`,
  175:       `${isEnglish ? "Quantity" : "数量"}: ${item.quantity}`,
  176:       `${isEnglish ? "2D Drawing" : "2D 图纸"}: ${
  177:         item.needDrawing
  178:           ? isEnglish ? "Required" : "需要"
  179:           : isEnglish ? "Not Required" : "暂不需要"
  180:       }`,
  181:     ].join("\n");
  182:   });
  183: 
  184:   return lines.join("\n\n");
  185: }
  186: export function SelectionCartProvider({
  187:   children,
  188: }: {
  189:   children: ReactNode;
  190: }) {
  191:   const pathname = usePathname();
  192:   const isEnglish = getLocaleFromPathname(pathname) === "en";
  193: 
  194:   const [items, setItems] = useState<SelectionCartItem[]>([]);
  195:   const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  196:   const [hasMounted, setHasMounted] = useState(false);
  197:   const [printTime, setPrintTime] = useState("");
  198: 
  199:   /* 读取本地缓存 */
  200:   useEffect(() => {
  201:     try {
  202:       const rawGlobalCart = window.localStorage.getItem(GLOBAL_CART_STORAGE_KEY);
  203: 
  204:       if (rawGlobalCart) {
  205:         let parsedGlobalCart: SelectionCartItem[] = [];
  206: 
  207:       try {
  208:         parsedGlobalCart = JSON.parse(rawGlobalCart) as SelectionCartItem[];
  209:       } catch {
  210:         parsedGlobalCart = [];
  211:       }
  212: 
  213:         setItems(
  214:           parsedGlobalCart.map((item) => {
  215:             return {
  216:               ...item,
  217:               quantity: Math.max(1, Number(item.quantity || 1)),
  218:               needDrawing: Boolean(item.needDrawing),
  219:             };
  220:           })
  221:         );
  222: 
  223:         setHasMounted(true);
  224:         return;
  225:       }
  226: 
  227:       /* 兼容旧版接头清单 */
  228:       const rawLegacyCart = window.localStorage.getItem(
  229:         LEGACY_FITTING_CART_STORAGE_KEY
  230:       );
  231: 
  232:       if (rawLegacyCart) {
  233:         let parsedLegacyCart: any = [];
  234: 
  235:       try {
  236:         parsedLegacyCart = JSON.parse(rawLegacyCart);
  237:       } catch {
  238:         parsedLegacyCart = [];
  239:       }
  240:         const migratedItems = normalizeLegacyFittingItems(parsedLegacyCart);
  241: 
  242:         setItems(migratedItems);
  243:       }
  244:     } catch {
  245:       setItems([]);
  246:     }
  247: 
  248:     setHasMounted(true);
  249:   }, []);
  250: 
  251:   /* 写入本地缓存 */
  252:   useEffect(() => {
  253:     if (!hasMounted) return;
  254: 
  255:     window.localStorage.setItem(GLOBAL_CART_STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(items));
  256:   }, [items, hasMounted]);
  257: 
  258:   function openCart() {
  259:     setIsOpen(true);
  260:   }
  261: 
  262:   function closeCart() {
  263:     setIsOpen(false);
  264:   }
  265: 
  266:   function addItem(input: SelectionCartItemInput) {
  267:     const id =
  268:       input.id ||
  269:       buildCartItemId({
  270:         sourceType: input.sourceType,
  271:         productCode: input.productCode,
  272:       });
  273: 
  274:     const quantity = Math.max(1, Number(input.quantity || 1));
  275: 
  276:     setItems((prev) => {
  277:       const existingItem = prev.find((item) => item.id === id);
  278: 
  279:       if (existingItem) {
  280:         return prev.map((item) => {
  281:           if (item.id !== id) return item;
  282: 
  283:           return {
  284:             ...item,
  285:             quantity: item.quantity + quantity,
  286:             needDrawing: Boolean(item.needDrawing || input.needDrawing),
  287:           };
  288:         });
  289:       }
  290: 
  291:       return [
  292:         ...prev,
  293:         {
  294:           ...input,
  295:           id,
  296:           quantity,
  297:           needDrawing: Boolean(input.needDrawing),
  298:         },
  299:       ];
  300:     });
  301:   }
  302: 
  303:   function removeItem(id: string) {
  304:     setItems((prev) => prev.filter((item) => item.id !== id));
  305:   }
  306: 
  307:   function clearCart() {
  308:     const confirmed = window.confirm(
  309:       isEnglish
  310:         ? "Clear the current product selection list?"
  311:         : "确认清空当前选型清单？",
  312:     );
  313: 
  314:     if (!confirmed) return;
  315: 
  316:     setItems([]);
  317:   }
  318: 
  319:   function changeQuantity(id: string, quantity: number) {
  320:     setItems((prev) => {
  321:       return prev.map((item) => {
  322:         if (item.id !== id) return item;
  323: 
  324:         return {
  325:           ...item,
  326:           quantity: Math.max(1, Number(quantity || 1)),
  327:         };
  328:       });
  329:     });
  330:   }
  331: 
  332:   function toggleDrawingNeed(id: string, needDrawing: boolean) {
  333:     setItems((prev) => {
  334:       return prev.map((item) => {
  335:         if (item.id !== id) return item;
  336: 
  337:         return {
  338:           ...item,
  339:           needDrawing,
  340:         };
  341:       });
  342:     });
  343:   }
  344: 
  345:   function getItem(sourceType: SelectionCartSourceType, productCode: string) {
  346:     const id = buildCartItemId({
  347:       sourceType,
  348:       productCode,
  349:     });
  350: 
  351:     return items.find((item) => item.id === id);
  352:   }
  353: 
  354:   async function copyCartText() {
  355:     const text = buildCartText(items, isEnglish);
  356: 
  357:     try {
  358:       await window.navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
  359:       window.alert(
  360:         isEnglish
  361:           ? "Selection list copied"
  362:           : "清单已复制",
  363:       );
  364:     } catch {
  365:       window.alert(text);
  366:     }
  367:   }
  368: 
  369:   function generatePdfList() {
  370:     if (items.length === 0) {
  371:       window.alert(
  372:         isEnglish
  373:           ? "The selection list is empty. Add a product first."
  374:           : "当前清单为空，请先加入产品。",
  375:       );
  376:       return;
  377:     }
  378: 
  379:     setPrintTime(
  380:       new Date().toLocaleString(isEnglish ? "en-US" : "zh-CN"),
  381:     );
  382: 
  383:     window.setTimeout(() => {
  384:       window.print();
  385:     }, 80);
  386:   }
  387: 
  388:   const contextValue = useMemo<SelectionCartContextValue>(() => {
  389:     return {
  390:       items,
  391:       isOpen,
  392:       openCart,
  393:       closeCart,
  394:       addItem,
  395:       removeItem,
  396:       clearCart,
  397:       changeQuantity,
  398:       toggleDrawingNeed,
  399:       getItem,
  400:       copyCartText,
  401:       generatePdfList,
  402:       printTime,
  403:     };
  404:   }, [isEnglish, items, isOpen, printTime]);
  405: 
  406:   return (
  407:     <SelectionCartContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
  408:       {children}
  409:     </SelectionCartContext.Provider>
  410:   );
  411: }
  412: 
  413: /* =========================================================
  414:    useSelectionCart
  415: ========================================================= */
  416: export function useSelectionCart() {
  417:   const context = useContext(SelectionCartContext);
  418: 
  419:   if (!context) {
  420:     throw new Error(
  421:       "useSelectionCart must be used inside SelectionCartProvider."
  422:     );
  423:   }
  424: 
  425:   return context;
  426: }

    1: /* =========================================================
    2:    fitting-replacement.types.ts
    3:    恒永达官网｜接头替代查询数据类型定义
    4: 
    5:    文件路径：

    7: 
    8:    作用：
    9:    1. 统一约束接头替代查询模块的数据结构
   10:    2. 防止商品编码、型号、兼容型号、图片路径、图纸路径等字段写乱
   11:    3. 当前服务：
   12:       - Q20 快插接头替代查询
   13:       - 中文页面 /resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement
   14:       - 多语言页面 /en/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement 等
   15:    4. 后续 Q40 / Q60 / 硬管接头 / 倒刺接头 / 鲁尔接头扩展时继续复用
   16:    5. 后续从 Excel / 后台 / 数据库导入时，也尽量保持同一套字段
   17: ========================================================= */
   18: 
   19: /* =========================================================
   20:    多语言文本
   21: 
   22:    说明：
   23:    1. 型号解析规则会服务中文、英文、西语、法语、韩语、俄语
   24:    2. zh 为主语言
   25:    3. 其他语言如果暂时没有，可以不填
   26: ========================================================= */
   27: export interface FittingReplacementI18nText {
   28:   zh: string; // 中文
   29:   en?: string; // 英文
   30:   es?: string; // 西班牙语
   31:   fr?: string; // 法语
   32:   ko?: string; // 韩语
   33:   ru?: string; // 俄语
   34: }
   35: 
   36: /* =========================================================
   37:    接头型号解析规则
   38: 
   39:    示例：
   40:    Q2001-PMV-SPPE
   41:    可以拆成：
   42:    Q20 | 01 | P | M | V | S | PP | E
   43: 
   44:    注意：
   45:    1. 同一个代码在不同位置可能含义不同
   46:    2. 例如 S 在“公母端”里表示母端
   47:    3. S 在“形状”里表示直通
   48:    4. 所以必须通过 fieldKey / fieldName 来判断含义
   49:    5. 不能只看代码本身
   50: ========================================================= */
   51: export interface FittingModelRule {
   52:   /* 适用系列，例如 Q20 */
   53:   series: string;
   54: 
   55:   /* 字段顺序，用于前台展示排序 */
   56:   fieldOrder: number;
   57: 
   58:   /* 字段唯一标识，代码里使用，建议英文小写 */
   59:   fieldKey:
   60:   | "series"
   61:   | "tubeOrThread"
   62:   | "gender"
   63:   | "panelMount"
   64:   | "valved"
   65:   | "shape"
   66:   | "housingMaterial"
   67:   | "sealingRingMaterial";
   68: 
   69:   /* 字段名称，例如：管尺寸或螺纹、公母端、是否带阀 */
   70:   fieldName: FittingReplacementI18nText;
   71: 
   72:   /* 取值位置说明，例如：第2段第1位、第3段中间字符 */
   73:   positionDescription: string;
   74: 
   75:   /* 代码，例如 Q20、01、P、M、V、S、PP、E */
   76:   code: string;
   77: 
   78:   /* 代码含义，例如：公端、穿板、EPDM */
   79:   meaning: FittingReplacementI18nText;
   80: }
   81: 
   82: /* =========================================================
   83:    接头替代查询产品数据
   84: 
   85:    说明：
   86:    1. 商品编码是内部唯一 ID
   87:    2. 型号用于解析产品含义
   88:    3. 兼容型号用于客户搜索
   89:    4. 产品图按型号自动匹配
   90:    5. 2D 图纸 PDF 也按型号自动匹配
   91: ========================================================= */
   92: export interface FittingReplacementProduct {
   93:   /* 商品编码，例如 839085 */

   95: 
   96:   /* 恒永达型号，例如 Q2001-PMV-SPPE */

   98: 
   99:   /* 兼容型号列表，例如 A0018 / B0007 / C0007 */
  100:   competitorModels: string[];
  101: 
  102:   /* 包装，例如 25pcs/pkg */
  103:   packageText?: string;
  104: 
  105:   /* 是否显示在首页卡片里 */
  106:   showOnHome: boolean;
  107: 
  108:   /* 内部备注或前台备注，暂时可为空 */
  109:   note?: string;
  110: 
  111:   /* 产品图片路径，后续根据型号自动生成 */
  112:   imagePath: string;
  113: 
  114:   /* 2D 图纸 PDF 路径，后续根据型号自动生成 */
  115:   drawingPdfPath: string;
  116: 
  117:   /* 对应的正式产品详情页；尚未建设详情页时为空 */
  118:   detailHref?: string;
  119: 
  120:   /* 前台辅助展示的产品分类和系列 */
  121:   productType?: string;
  122:   productSeries?: string;
  123: }
  124: 
  125: /* =========================================================

  133: export interface ParsedFittingModelField {

文件：data\resources\fitting-replacement\fitting-replacement-series.config.ts

    1: /* =========================================================
    2:    fitting-replacement-series.config.ts
    3:    恒永达官网｜接头替代查询系列配置
    4: 
    5:    文件路径：
    6:    data/resources/fitting-replacement/fitting-replacement-series.config.ts
    7: 
    8:    作用：
    9:    1. 统一管理接头替代查询不同系列的基础配置
   10:    2. 避免在 Home / Detail / Guide 组件里到处写死 q20 路径
   11:    3. 为后续 Q40 / Q60 / 其他接头系列做模板
   12:    4. 支持中文路径和多语言路径
   13:    5. 解决外语页面点击详情后跳回中文详情页的问题
   14: 
   15:    当前支持：
   16:    1. Q20 快插接头
   17: 
   18:    后续扩展示例：
   19:    q40: {
   20:      seriesKey: "q40",
   21:      seriesCode: "Q40",
   22:      productName: "Q40 快插接头",
   23:      ...
   24:    }
   25: ========================================================= */
   26: 
   27: export type FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20";
   28: 
   29: /* =========================================================
   30:    接头系列配置类型
   31: 
   32:    字段说明：
   33:    1. seriesKey：用于 URL 路径，例如 q20
   34:    2. seriesCode：用于显示系列，例如 Q20
   35:    3. productName：用于清单和卡片展示
   36:    4. sourceType：用于全局选型清单区分来源
   37:    5. sourceLabel：用于全局选型清单显示来源名称
   38:    6. homeHref：中文接头替代查询首页路径
   39:    7. detailBaseHref：中文当前系列详情页基础路径
   40:    8. drawingBaseHref：当前系列 2D 图纸 PDF 文件夹路径
   41: ========================================================= */
   42: export interface FittingReplacementSeriesConfig {
   43:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey;
   44:   seriesCode: string;
   45:   productName: string;
   46:   sourceType: "fitting-replacement";
   47:   sourceLabel: string;
   48:   homeHref: string;
   49:   detailBaseHref: string;
   50:   drawingBaseHref: string;
   51: }
   52: 
   53: /* =========================================================
   54:    Q20 系列配置
   55: 
   56:    注意：
   57:    1. 中文默认路径不加 /zh-CN
   58:    2. 外语路径在 getFittingReplacementDetailHref 中动态加前缀
   59:    3. public 目录下文件引用时，不需要写 public
   60: ========================================================= */
   61: export const Q20_FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG: FittingReplacementSeriesConfig =
   62:   {
   63:     seriesKey: "q20",
   64:     seriesCode: "Q20",
   65:     productName: "接头产品",
   66:     sourceType: "fitting-replacement",
   67:     sourceLabel: "接头兼容型号查询",
   68:     homeHref: "/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement",
   69:     detailBaseHref: "/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20",
   70:     drawingBaseHref:
   71:       "/downloads/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/drawings",
   72:   };
   73: 
   74: /* =========================================================
   75:    系列配置集合
   76: 
   77:    说明：
   78:    后续新增 q40 / q60 时，在这里继续补。
   79: ========================================================= */
   80: export const FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG_MAP: Record<
   81:   FittingReplacementSeriesKey,
   82:   FittingReplacementSeriesConfig
   83: > = {
   84:   q20: Q20_FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG,
   85: };
   86: 
   87: /* =========================================================
   88:    获取系列配置
   89: 
   90:    说明：
   91:    1. 当前默认返回 Q20
   92:    2. 后续如果详情页路由扩展为 /[seriesKey]/[productCode]
   93:       可以根据 seriesKey 动态读取
   94: ========================================================= */
   95: export function getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(
   96:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
   97: ) {
   98:   return FITTING_REPLACEMENT_SERIES_CONFIG_MAP[seriesKey];
   99: }
  100: 
  101: /* =========================================================
  102:    生成语言前缀
  103: 
  104:    说明：
  105:    1. 中文页面不加语言前缀
  106:    2. 外语页面加 /en /es /fr /ko /ru
  107:    3. 避免外语页面点击详情后跳回中文路径
  108: ========================================================= */
  109: function getLocalePathPrefix(locale: string = "zh") {
  110:   if (!locale || locale === "zh" || locale === "zh-CN") {
  111:     return "";
  112:   }
  113: 
  114:   return `/${locale}`;
  115: }
  116: 
  117: /* =========================================================
  118:    生成接头替代查询首页路径
  119: 
  120:    示例：
  121:    中文：/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement
  122:    英文：/en/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement
  123: ========================================================= */
  124: export function getFittingReplacementHomeHref(
  125:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20",
  126:   locale: string = "zh"
  127: ) {
  128:   const config = getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(seriesKey);
  129:   const localePrefix = getLocalePathPrefix(locale);
  130: 
  131:   return `${localePrefix}${config.homeHref}`;
  132: }
  133: 
  134: /* =========================================================
  135:    生成详情页路径
  136: 
  137:    示例：
  138:    中文：
  139:    /resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/839041
  140: 
  141:    英文：
  142:    /en/resources/selection-support/fitting-replacement/q20/839041
  143: 
  144:    说明：
  145:    1. locale 默认是 zh，兼容旧调用
  146:    2. 外语首页 / 选型指引进入详情页时，需要传入当前 locale
  147: ========================================================= */
  148: export function getFittingReplacementDetailHref(
  149:   productCode: string,
  150:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20",
  151:   locale: string = "zh"
  152: ) {
  153:   const config = getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(seriesKey);
  154:   const localePrefix = getLocalePathPrefix(locale);
  155: 
  156:   return `${localePrefix}${config.detailBaseHref}/${encodeURIComponent(
  157:     productCode
  158:   )}`;
  159: }
  160: 
  161: /* =========================================================
  162:    生成 2D 图纸 PDF 路径
  163: 
  164:    说明：
  165:    1. PDF 是 public 静态资源
  166:    2. 不需要加语言前缀
  167:    3. 中文和外语详情页共用同一份图纸文件
  168: ========================================================= */
  169: export function getFittingReplacementDrawingPdfHref(
  170:   foreachModel: string,
  171:   seriesKey: FittingReplacementSeriesKey = "q20"
  172: ) {
  173:   const config = getFittingReplacementSeriesConfig(seriesKey);
  174: 
  175:   return `${config.drawingBaseHref}/${foreachModel}.pdf`;
  176: }

    1: const fs = require("fs");
    2: const path = require("path");
    3: const xlsx = require("xlsx");
    4: 
    5: const SOURCE_FILE = "data-source/product-center/pumps/FOREACH_隔膜泵系列_产品数据源.xlsx";
    6: const OUT_DIR = "data/products/generated/pumps/diaphragm-pumps";
    7: 
    8: function n(v) {
    9:   return String(v ?? "").trim();
   10: }
   11: 
   12: function ensureDir(dir) {
   13:   fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
   14: }
   15: 
   16: function writeJson(filePath, data) {
   17:   ensureDir(path.dirname(filePath));
   18:   fs.writeFileSync(filePath, JSON.stringify(data, null, 2), "utf8");
   19: }
   20: 
   21: function readSheet(wb, sheetName) {
   22:   const ws = wb.Sheets[sheetName];
   23:   if (!ws) throw new Error(`缺少 Sheet: ${sheetName}`);
   24:   return xlsx.utils.sheet_to_json(ws, { defval: "" }).map(row => {
   25:     const out = {};
   26:     for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(row)) out[n(k)] = n(v);
   27:     return out;
   28:   }).filter(row => Object.values(row).some(Boolean));
   29: }
   30: 
   31: function by(rows, key) {
   32:   const map = {};
   33:   for (const row of rows) {
   34:     const v = n(row[key]);
   35:     if (!v) continue;
   36:     if (!map[v]) map[v] = [];
   37:     map[v].push(row);
   38:   }
   39:   return map;
   40: }
   41: 
   42: function oneBy(rows, key) {
   43:   const map = {};
   44:   for (const row of rows) {
   45:     const v = n(row[key]);
   46:     if (v) map[v] = row;
   47:   }
   48:   return map;
   49: }
   50: 
   51: function publicFullPath(dir, file) {
   52:   let d = n(dir).replaceAll("\\", "/").replace(/\/+$/, "");
   53:   const f = n(file);
   54: 
   55:   if (!d || !f) return "";
   56: 
   57:   // Excel 里如果写的是 /public/images/...，转换成 public/images/...
   58:   // Excel 里如果写的是 /images/...，转换成 public/images/...
   59:   // Excel 里如果写的是 public/images/...，保持不变
   60:   if (d.startsWith("/public/")) {
   61:     d = d.slice(1);
   62:   } else if (d.startsWith("/")) {
   63:     d = `public${d}`;
   64:   } else if (!d.startsWith("public/")) {
   65:     d = `public/${d}`;
   66:   }
   67: 
   68:   return path.join(d, f).replaceAll("\\", "/");
   69: }
   70: 
   71: function checkRequired(rows, sheetName, fields) {
   72:   let ok = true;
   73:   for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
   74:     for (const field of fields) {
   75:       if (!n(rows[i][field])) {
   76:         console.log(`ERROR: ${sheetName} 第 ${i + 2} 行缺少字段：${field}`);
   77:         ok = false;
   78:       }
   79:     }
   80:   }
   81:   if (ok) console.log(`OK: ${sheetName} 已检查 ${rows.length} 行`);
   82:   return ok;
   83: }
   84: 
   85: function dupCheck(rows, field, label) {
   86:   const map = new Map();
   87:   for (const row of rows) {
   88:     const v = n(row[field]);
   89:     if (!v) continue;
   90:     map.set(v, (map.get(v) || 0) + 1);
   91:   }
   92:   const dup = [...map.entries()].filter(([, count]) => count > 1);
   93:   if (dup.length) {
   94:     console.log(`ERROR: ${label} 重复：`);
   95:     console.log(dup);
   96:     return false;
   97:   }
   98:   console.log(`OK: ${label} 无重复`);
   99:   return true;
  100: }
  101: 
  102: function main() {

  104:     throw new Error(`未找到数据源：${SOURCE_FILE}`);

  147:   console.log("资源命名规则:", namingRows.length);
  148: 
  149:   console.log("\n=== 关键字段检查 ===");
  150:   ok = true;
  151:   ok = checkRequired(seriesRows, "01_系列详情", ["series_id", "页面标题", "slug", "路径建议"]) && ok;
  152:   ok = checkRequired(cardRows, "02_选型卡片", ["card_id", "卡片标题/型号", "卡片描述", "目标系列slug"]) && ok;
  153:   ok = checkRequired(specRows, "03_规格参数", ["series_id", "规格表名称", "参数", "规格值"]) && ok;
  154:   ok = checkRequired(modelRows, "04_型号配置", ["series_id", "产品型号", "电压"]) && ok;
  155:   ok = checkRequired(faqRows, "05_FAQ", ["series_id", "问题", "答案"]) && ok;
  156:   ok = checkRequired(mediaRows, "06_媒体资源索引", ["series_id", "资源类型", "标准文件名", "推荐存放路径", "ALT文本_EN"]) && ok;
  157:   ok = checkRequired(routeRows, "07_路由SEO", ["series_id", "中文页面标题", "slug_EN", "路径建议"]) && ok;
  158: 
  159:   console.log("\n=== 重复检查 ===");
  160:   ok = dupCheck(seriesRows, "slug", "系列 slug") && ok;
  161:   ok = dupCheck(routeRows, "slug_EN", "路由 slug_EN") && ok;
  162:   ok = dupCheck(routeRows, "路径建议", "路径建议") && ok;
  163: 
  164:   console.log("\n=== 媒体资源路径提示，不阻塞 ===");

   33: function text(value: unknown): string {
   34:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
   35:   return String(value).trim();
   36: }
   37: 
   38: function normalize(value: string): string {
   39:   return value
   40:     .toUpperCase()
   41:     .replace(/[‐‑‒–—―﹘﹣－]/g, "-")
   42:     .replace(/\s+/g, "");

   45: function getFiles(dir: string): string[] {
   46:   if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) return [];
   47: 
   48:   return fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
   49:     const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
   50: 
   51:     if (entry.isDirectory()) return getFiles(fullPath);
   52: 
   53:     if (
   54:       entry.isFile() &&
   55:       (
   56:         entry.name.endsWith(".ts") ||
   57:         entry.name.endsWith(".json")
   58:       ) &&
   59:       !entry.name.includes(".bak")
   60:     ) {
   61:       return [fullPath];
   62:     }
   63: 
   64:     return [];
   65:   });
   66: }
   67: 
   68: function firstText(
   69:   object: Record<string, unknown>,
   70:   keys: string[]
   71: ): string {
   72:   for (const key of keys) {
   73:     const value = text(object[key]);
   74:     if (value) return value;
   75:   }
   76: 
   77:   return "";
   78: }

   80: function collectCandidates(
   81:   value: unknown,
   82:   sourceFile: string,
   83:   candidates: Candidate[],
   84:   seen: WeakSet<object>
   85: ) {
   86:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;
   87: 
   88:   const objectValue = value as object;
   89:   if (seen.has(objectValue)) return;
   90:   seen.add(objectValue);
   91: 
   92:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   93:     for (const item of value) {
   94:       collectCandidates(item, sourceFile, candidates, seen);
   95:     }
   96:     return;
   97:   }
   98: 
   99:   const object = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  100: 
  101:   const productCode = firstText(object, [
  102:     "productCode",
  103:     "goodsCode",
  104:     "sku",
  105:     "code",
  106:   ]);
  107: 
  108:   const model = firstText(object, [
  109:     "foreachModel",
  110:     "model",
  111:     "modelNumber",
  112:     "title",
  113:   ]);
  114: 
  115:   const detailHref = firstText(object, [
  116:     "detailHref",
  117:     "href",
  118:     "detailUrl",
  119:     "url",
  120:   ]);
  121: 
  122:   const imagePath = firstText(object, [
  123:     "imagePath",
  124:     "imageSrc",
  125:     "image",
  126:     "coverImage",
  127:     "mainImage",
  128:   ]);
  129: 
  130:   if ((productCode || model) && (detailHref || imagePath)) {
  131:     candidates.push({
  132:       sourceFile,
  133:       productCode,
  134:       model,
  135:       detailHref,
  136:       imagePath,
  137:     });
  138:   }
  139: 
  140:   for (const child of Object.values(object)) {
  141:     collectCandidates(child, sourceFile, candidates, seen);
  142:   }
  143: }
  144: 
  145: async function loadCandidates(): Promise<{
  146:   candidates: Candidate[];
  147:   importErrors: string[];
  148: }> {
  149:   const files = SEARCH_DIRS.flatMap(getFiles);
  150:   const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
  151:   const importErrors: string[] = [];
  152: 
  153:   for (const file of files) {
  154:     const relative = path.relative(ROOT, file).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  155: 
  156:     try {
  157:       if (file.endsWith(".json")) {
  158:         const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  159:         collectCandidates(parsed, relative, candidates, new WeakSet());
  160:         continue;
  161:       }
  162: 
  163:       const module = await import(
  164:         `${pathToFileURL(file).href}?audit=${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`
  165:       );
  166: 
  167:       collectCandidates(module, relative, candidates, new WeakSet());
  168:     } catch (error) {
  169:       importErrors.push(
  170:         `${relative}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`
  171:       );
  172:     }
  173:   }
  174: 
  175:   return { candidates, importErrors };
  176: }
  177: 
  178: function findBestCandidates(
  179:   product: FittingCompatibleModelProduct,
  180:   candidates: Candidate[]
  181: ) {
  182:   const code = normalize(product.productCode);
  183:   const model = normalize(product.foreachModel);
  184: 
  185:   const codeMatches = candidates.filter((candidate) => {
  186:     return candidate.productCode && normalize(candidate.productCode) === code;
  187:   });
  188: 
  189:   if (codeMatches.length > 0) return codeMatches;
  190: 
  191:   return candidates.filter((candidate) => {
  192:     return candidate.model && normalize(candidate.model) === model;
  193:   });
  194: }
  195: 
  196: function uniqueCandidates(candidates: Candidate[]): Candidate[] {
  197:   const map = new Map<string, Candidate>();
  198: 
  199:   for (const candidate of candidates) {
  200:     const key = [
  201:       candidate.productCode,
  202:       candidate.model,
  203:       candidate.detailHref,
  204:       candidate.imagePath,
  205:     ].join("::");
  206: 
  207:     if (!map.has(key)) map.set(key, candidate);
  208:   }
  209: 
  210:   return [...map.values()];
  211: }
  212: 
  213: async function main() {
  214:   const { candidates, importErrors } = await loadCandidates();
  215: 
  216:   const rows = fittingCompatibleModelProducts.map((product) => {
  217:     const matches = uniqueCandidates(findBestCandidates(product, candidates));
  218:

  220:     const imageMatches = matches.filter((item) => item.imagePath);
  221:

  226:       imagePath: imageMatches[0]?.imagePath ?? "",

  228:   });

  238:     const hrefs = new Set(
  239:       row.matches.map((item) => item.detailHref).filter(Boolean)
  240:     );
  241: 
  242:     return hrefs.size > 1;

  244:

  251:     `- 缺少产品图片：${missingImage.length}`,
  252:     `- 匹配到多个详情路径：${ambiguous.length}`,
  253:     `- 数据模块读取失败：${importErrors.length}`,
  254:     "",

  256:     "",

  258:

  263:     for (const row of missingDetail) {
  264:       lines.push(
  265:         `| ${row.product.productCode} | ${row.product.foreachModel} | ${row.product.productType} | ${row.product.productSeries} |`
  266:       );
  267:     }
  268:     lines.push("");
  269:   }
  270:

  274:     lines.push("未发现。", "");
  275:   } else {
  276:     lines.push("| 商品编码 | FOREACH 型号 | 分类 | 系列 |", "|---|---|---|---|");
  277:     for (const row of missingImage) {
  278:       lines.push(
  279:         `| ${row.product.productCode} | ${row.product.foreachModel} | ${row.product.productType} | ${row.product.productSeries} |`
  280:       );
  281:     }
  282:     lines.push("");
  283:   }
  284:

  289:   } else {
  290:     for (const row of ambiguous) {

  292:       for (const match of row.matches) {

  307:     lines.push("");

  309:

  311:

  316:   console.log(`缺少详情页：${missingDetail.length}`);
  317:   console.log(`缺少图片：${missingImage.length}`);
  318:   console.log(`多详情路径：${ambiguous.length}`);
  319:   console.log(`模块读取失败：${importErrors.length}`);

  102:   const productCode = firstText(object, [
  103:     "productCode",
  104:     "goodsCode",
  105:     "sku",
  106:     "code",
  107:   ]);
  108: 
  109:   const model = firstText(object, [
  110:     "foreachModel",
  111:     "model",
  112:     "modelNumber",
  113:     "title",
  114:   ]);
  115: 
  116:   const detailHref = firstText(object, [
  117:     "detailHref",
  118:     "href",
  119:     "detailUrl",
  120:     "url",
  121:   ]);
  122: 
  123:   const imagePath = firstText(object, [
  124:     "imagePath",
  125:     "imageSrc",
  126:     "image",
  127:     "coverImage",
  128:     "mainImage",
  129:   ]);
  130: 
  131:   if ((productCode || model) && (detailHref || imagePath)) {
  132:     candidates.push({
  133:       sourceFile,
  134:       productCode,
  135:       model,
  136:       detailHref,
  137:       imagePath,
  138:     });
  139:   }
  140: 
  141:   for (const child of Object.values(object)) {
  142:     collectCandidates(child, sourceFile, candidates, seen);
  143:   }
  144: }
  145: 
  146: async function loadCandidates(): Promise<Candidate[]> {
  147:   const files = SEARCH_DIRS.flatMap(getFiles);
  148:   const candidates: Candidate[] = [];
  149: 
  150:   for (const file of files) {
  151:     const relative = path.relative(ROOT, file).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  152: 
  153:     try {
  154:       if (file.endsWith(".json")) {
  155:         const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  156:         collectCandidates(parsed, relative, candidates, new WeakSet());
  157:         continue;
  158:       }
  159: 
  160:       const module = await import(
  161:         `${pathToFileURL(file).href}?build=${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`
  162:       );
  163: 
  164:       collectCandidates(module, relative, candidates, new WeakSet());
  165:     } catch {
  166:       // 单个辅助数据文件无法导入时跳过，不中断正式数据生成。
  167:     }
  168:   }
  169: 
  170:   return candidates;
  171: }
  172: 
  173: function findCandidates(
  174:   product: FittingCompatibleModelProduct,
  175:   candidates: Candidate[]
  176: ): Candidate[] {
  177:   const productCode = normalize(product.productCode);
  178:   const foreachModel = normalize(product.foreachModel);
  179: 
  180:   const codeMatches = candidates.filter((candidate) => {
  181:     return (
  182:       candidate.productCode &&
  183:       normalize(candidate.productCode) === productCode
  184:     );
  185:   });
  186: 
  187:   if (codeMatches.length > 0) return codeMatches;
  188: 
  189:   return candidates.filter((candidate) => {
  190:     return candidate.model && normalize(candidate.model) === foreachModel;
  191:   });
  192: }
  193: 
  194: function detailHrefScore(href: string): number {
  195:   if (!href) return -1;
  196:   if (!href.startsWith("/products/")) return 0;
  197:   if (href.includes("#")) return 20;
  198: 
  199:   const segments = href.split("/").filter(Boolean);
  200: 
  201:   /*
  202:     正式详情页通常为：
  203:     /products/fittings/quick-connect-fittings/q2001-pmv-sacn
  204:     分类页通常少一层。
  205:   */
  206:   if (segments.length >= 4) return 100;
  207: 
  208:   return 10;
  209: }
  210: 
  211: function chooseDetailHref(candidates: Candidate[]): string {
  212:   return [...new Set(candidates.map((item) => item.detailHref).filter(Boolean))]
  213:     .sort((a, b) => detailHrefScore(b) - detailHrefScore(a))[0] ?? "";
  214: }
  215: 
  216: function isUsableProductImage(imagePath: string): boolean {
  217:   if (!imagePath.startsWith("/")) return false;
  218: 
  219:   return (
  220:     !imagePath.includes("/images/logo/") &&
  221:     !imagePath.endsWith("foreach-logo-color.svg")
  222:   );
  223: }
  224: 
  225: function chooseImagePath(candidates: Candidate[]): string {
  226:   return (
  227:     candidates
  228:       .map((item) => item.imagePath)
  229:       .find(isUsableProductImage) ??
  230:     PLACEHOLDER_IMAGE
  231:   );
  232: }
  233: 
  234: function buildProducts(
  235:   candidates: Candidate[]
  236: ) {
  237:   return fittingCompatibleModelProducts.map((product) => {
  238:     const matches = findCandidates(product, candidates);
  239:     const detailHref = chooseDetailHref(matches);
  240:     const imagePath = chooseImagePath(matches);
  241: 
  242:     return {
  243:       productCode: product.productCode,
  244:       foreachModel: product.foreachModel,
  245: 
  246:       /*
  247:         为兼容当前选型清单结构，内部字段名暂时保留 competitorModels。
  248:         前台文案和页面中一律显示为“兼容型号”。
  249:       */
  250:       competitorModels: product.compatibleModels,
  251: 
  252:       packageText: "",
  253:       showOnHome: true,
  254:       note: "",
  255:       imagePath,
  256:       drawingPdfPath: "",
  257:       detailHref,
  258:       productType: product.productType,
  259:       productSeries: product.productSeries,
  260:     };
  261:   });
  262: }

  272: 
  273: import type { FittingReplacementProduct } from "./fitting-replacement.types";
  274: 
  275: export const fittingReplacementAllCompatibleProducts:
  276:   FittingReplacementProduct[] =
  277: ${JSON.stringify(products, null, 2)};
  278: `;
  279: }
