   61: function text(value: Cell): string {
   62:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
   63:   return String(value).replace(/\u00a0/g, " ").trim();
   64: }
   65: 
   66: function normalizeModel(value: string): string {
   67:   return value
   68:     .trim()
   69:     .toUpperCase()
   70:     .replace(/[‐‑‒–—―﹘﹣－]/g, "-")
   71:     .replace(/\s+/g, "");
   72: }
   73: 
   74: function isEmptyCompatibleValue(value: string): boolean {
   75:   const normalized = value.trim().toUpperCase();
   76:   return (
   77:     !normalized ||
   78:     normalized === "/" ||
   79:     normalized === "-" ||
   80:     normalized === "—" ||
   81:     normalized === "×" ||
   82:     normalized === "√" ||
   83:     normalized === "无" ||
   84:     normalized === "N/A" ||
   85:     normalized === "NA" ||
   86:     normalized === "NONE"
   87:   );
   88: }
   89: 
   90: function splitSlashOutsideFractions(value: string): string[] {
   91:   const parts: string[] = [];
   92:   let startIndex = 0;
   93: 
   94:   for (let index = 0; index < value.length; index += 1) {
   95:     if (value[index] !== "/") continue;
   96: 
   97:     const previous = value[index - 1] ?? "";
   98:     const next = value[index + 1] ?? "";
   99: 
  100:     /*
  101:       1/4、3/8 等数字分数属于型号的一部分，不能拆开。
  102:       P-213x/P-232x 这类斜杠两侧不是纯数字，应拆成两个可搜索型号。
  103:     */
  104:     if (/\d/.test(previous) && /\d/.test(next)) {
  105:       continue;
  106:     }
  107: 
  108:     parts.push(value.slice(startIndex, index));
  109:     startIndex = index + 1;
  110:   }
  111: 
  112:   parts.push(value.slice(startIndex));
  113: 
  114:   return parts.map((item) => item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  115: }
  116: 
  117: function splitCompatibleModels(rawValue: string): string[] {
  118:   if (isEmptyCompatibleValue(rawValue)) return [];
  119: 
  120:   const firstPass = rawValue
  121:     .replace(/\r/g, "\n")
  122:     .split(/[\n,，;；]+/)
  123:     .map((item) => item.trim())
  124:     .filter(Boolean);
  125: 
  126:   const expanded = firstPass.flatMap((item) => {
  127:     return splitSlashOutsideFractions(item);
  128:   });
  129: 
  130:   const unique = new Map<string, string>();
  131: 
  132:   for (const item of expanded) {
  133:     if (isEmptyCompatibleValue(item)) continue;
  134: 
  135:     const normalized = normalizeModel(item);
  136: 
  137:     if (!normalized) continue;
  138:     if (!unique.has(normalized)) unique.set(normalized, item);
  139:   }
  140: 
  141:   return [...unique.values()];
  142: }
  143: function findHeaderIndex(headers: Cell[], name: string): number {
  144:   return headers.findIndex((cell) => text(cell).includes(name));
  145: }
  146: 
  147: function extractForeachModel(rawName: string, productCode: string): string {
  148:   let value = text(rawName);
  149: 
  150:   if (productCode) {
  151:     value = value.replace(
  152:       new RegExp(`\\s*${productCode.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")}\\s*$`),
  153:       ""
  154:     );
  155:   }
  156: 
  157:   const tokens = value.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  158:   const modelToken = [...tokens]
  159:     .reverse()
  160:     .find((token) => /[A-Z]/i.test(token) && /[-_]/.test(token));
  161: 
  162:   return modelToken ?? value;
  163: }
  164: 
  165: function yesMark(value: Cell): boolean {
  166:   const normalized = text(value).toUpperCase();
  167:   return normalized === "√" || normalized === "是" || normalized === "YES";
  168: }

  170: function readProducts(): ProductRecord[] {
  171:   if (!fs.existsSync(SOURCE)) {
  172:     throw new Error(`找不到数据源：${SOURCE}`);
  173:   }
  174: 
  175:   const workbook = XLSX.readFile(SOURCE, { cellDates: false });
  176:   const productMap = new Map<string, ProductRecord>();
  177: 
  178:   for (const sheetName of workbook.SheetNames) {
  179:     const sheet = workbook.Sheets[sheetName];
  180:     const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json<Cell[]>(sheet, {
  181:       header: 1,
  182:       defval: "",
  183:       raw: false,
  184:     });
  185: 
  186:     if (rows.length < 3) continue;
  187: 
  188:     const header1 = rows[0] ?? [];
  189:     const header2 = rows[1] ?? [];
  190: 
  191:     const typeIndex = findHeaderIndex(header1, "产品类型");
  192:     const seriesIndex = findHeaderIndex(header1, "产品系列");
  193:     const modelIndex = findHeaderIndex(header1, "恒永达型号");
  194:     const codeIndex = findHeaderIndex(header1, "商品编码");
  195:     const compatibleStart = findHeaderIndex(header1, "竞品型号");
  196:     const drawing2dIndex = findHeaderIndex(header1, "2D图编码");
  197:     const model3dIndex = findHeaderIndex(header1, "3D图编码");
  198: 
  199:     if (
  200:       modelIndex < 0 ||
  201:       codeIndex < 0 ||
  202:       compatibleStart < 0 ||
  203:       drawing2dIndex < 0
  204:     ) {
  205:       continue;
  206:     }
  207: 
  208:     const compatibleEnd = drawing2dIndex;
  209: 
  210:     for (let rowIndex = 2; rowIndex < rows.length; rowIndex += 1) {
  211:       const row = rows[rowIndex] ?? [];
  212:       const productCode = text(row[codeIndex]);
  213:       const productName = text(row[modelIndex]);
  214: 
  215:       if (!productCode || !productName) continue;
  216: 
  217:       const sources: SourceItem[] = [];
  218: 
  219:       for (let column = compatibleStart; column < compatibleEnd; column += 1) {
  220:         const rawValue = text(row[column]);
  221:         const models = splitCompatibleModels(rawValue);
  222:         const brand = text(header2[column]) || `来源${column - compatibleStart + 1}`;
  223: 
  224:         for (const model of models) {
  225:           sources.push({
  226:             brand,
  227:             model,
  228:             normalizedModel: normalizeModel(model),
  229:             sheet: sheetName,
  230:             row: rowIndex + 1,
  231:           });
  232:         }
  233:       }
  234: 
  235:       if (sources.length === 0) continue;
  236: 
  237:       const foreachModel = extractForeachModel(productName, productCode);
  238:       const key = `${productCode}::${foreachModel}`;
  239: 
  240:       const existing = productMap.get(key);
  241: 
  242:       if (existing) {
  243:         const sourceKeySet = new Set(
  244:           existing.compatibleSources.map(
  245:             (item) => `${item.brand}::${item.normalizedModel}`
  246:           )
  247:         );
  248: 
  249:         for (const source of sources) {
  250:           const sourceKey = `${source.brand}::${source.normalizedModel}`;
  251:           if (!sourceKeySet.has(sourceKey)) {
  252:             existing.compatibleSources.push(source);
  253:             sourceKeySet.add(sourceKey);
  254:           }
  255:         }
  256: 
  257:         existing.compatibleModels = [
  258:           ...new Map(
  259:             existing.compatibleSources.map((item) => [
  260:               item.normalizedModel,
  261:               item.model,
  262:             ])
  263:           ).values(),
  264:         ];
  265: 
  266:         continue;
  267:       }
  268: 
  269:       productMap.set(key, {
  270:         productType: typeIndex >= 0 ? text(row[typeIndex]) : "",
  271:         productSeries: seriesIndex >= 0 ? text(row[seriesIndex]) : "",
  272:         productName,
  273:         foreachModel,
  274:         productCode,
  275:         compatibleModels: [
  276:           ...new Map(
  277:             sources.map((item) => [item.normalizedModel, item.model])
  278:           ).values(),
  279:         ],
  280:         compatibleSources: sources,
  281:         hasDrawing2d: drawing2dIndex >= 0 ? yesMark(row[drawing2dIndex]) : false,
  282:         hasModel3d: model3dIndex >= 0 ? yesMark(row[model3dIndex]) : false,
  283:         sourceSheet: sheetName,
  284:         sourceRow: rowIndex + 1,
  285:       });
  286:     }
  287:   }
  288: 
  289:   return [...productMap.values()].sort((a, b) => {
  290:     return (
  291:       a.productType.localeCompare(b.productType, "zh-CN") ||
  292:       a.productSeries.localeCompare(b.productSeries, "zh-CN") ||
  293:       a.foreachModel.localeCompare(b.foreachModel, "en")
  294:     );
  295:   });
  296: }

  298: function buildAudit(products: ProductRecord[]) {
  299:   const modelMap = new Map<
  300:     string,
  301:     {
  302:       displayModels: Set<string>;
  303:       mappings: Map<string, {
  304:         productCode: string;
  305:         foreachModel: string;
  306:         productType: string;
  307:         productSeries: string;
  308:       }>;
  309:       brands: Set<string>;
  310:     }
  311:   >();
  312: 
  313:   for (const product of products) {
  314:     for (const source of product.compatibleSources) {
  315:       const item =
  316:         modelMap.get(source.normalizedModel) ??
  317:         {
  318:           displayModels: new Set<string>(),
  319:           mappings: new Map(),
  320:           brands: new Set<string>(),
  321:         };
  322: 
  323:       item.displayModels.add(source.model);
  324:       item.brands.add(source.brand);
  325:       item.mappings.set(`${product.productCode}::${product.foreachModel}`, {
  326:         productCode: product.productCode,
  327:         foreachModel: product.foreachModel,
  328:         productType: product.productType,
  329:         productSeries: product.productSeries,
  330:       });
  331: 
  332:       modelMap.set(source.normalizedModel, item);
  333:     }
  334:   }
  335: 
  336:   const duplicateMappings = [...modelMap.entries()]
  337:     .filter(([, item]) => item.mappings.size > 1)
  338:     .map(([normalizedModel, item]) => ({
  339:       normalizedModel,
  340:       displayModels: [...item.displayModels],
  341:       brands: [...item.brands],
  342:       products: [...item.mappings.values()],
  343:     }))
  344:     .sort((a, b) => a.normalizedModel.localeCompare(b.normalizedModel, "en"));
  345: 
  346:   const bySheet = Object.entries(
  347:     products.reduce<Record<string, number>>((result, product) => {
  348:       result[product.sourceSheet] = (result[product.sourceSheet] ?? 0) + 1;
  349:       return result;
  350:     }, {})
  351:   ).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b, "zh-CN"));
  352: 
  353:   const bySeries = Object.entries(
  354:     products.reduce<Record<string, number>>((result, product) => {
  355:       const key = `${product.productType} / ${product.productSeries}`;
  356:       result[key] = (result[key] ?? 0) + 1;
  357:       return result;
  358:     }, {})
  359:   ).sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b, "zh-CN"));
  360: 
  361:   const totalRelations = products.reduce(
  362:     (sum, product) => sum + product.compatibleSources.length,
  363:     0
  364:   );
  365: 
  366:   return {
  367:     generatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
  368:     productCount: products.length,
  369:     uniqueCompatibleModelCount: modelMap.size,
  370:     relationCount: totalRelations,
  371:     duplicateMappingCount: duplicateMappings.length,
  372:     bySheet,
  373:     bySeries,
  374:     duplicateMappings,
  375:   };
  376: }

  439:     ...audit.bySeries.map(([name, count]) => `| ${name} | ${count} |`),
  440:     "",
  441:     "## 一对多兼容型号",
  442:     "",
  443:   ];
  444: 
  445:   if (audit.duplicateMappings.length === 0) {
  446:     lines.push("未发现。");
  447:   } else {
  448:     for (const item of audit.duplicateMappings) {
  449:       lines.push(`### ${item.displayModels.join(" / ")}`);
  450:       lines.push("");
  451:       for (const product of item.products) {
  452:         lines.push(
  453:           `- ${product.foreachModel}（${product.productCode}，${product.productType} / ${product.productSeries}）`
  454:         );
  455:       }
  456:       lines.push("");
  457:     }
  458:   }
  459: 
  460:   lines.push(
  461:     "## 说明",
  462:     "",
  463:     "- 品牌名称仅保留在内部数据中，用于核对来源，前台不显示。",
  464:     "- 前台统一使用“兼容型号”，不使用“竞品”相关表述。",
  465:     "- 本步骤只生成数据，没有修改现有页面、样式、详情页或加入清单逻辑。",
  466:     ""
  467:   );
  468: 
  469:   return lines.join("\n");
  470: }

   27: function text(value: unknown): string {
   28:   if (value === null || value === undefined) return "";
   29: 
   30:   if (typeof value === "string") {
   31:     return value.trim();
   32:   }
   33: 
   34:   if (
   35:     typeof value === "number" ||
   36:     typeof value === "boolean"
   37:   ) {
   38:     return String(value).trim();
   39:   }
   40: 
   41:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
   42:     return value
   43:       .map((item) => text(item))
   44:       .filter(Boolean)
   45:       .join(" ")
   46:       .trim();
   47:   }
   48: 
   49:   if (typeof value === "object") {
   50:     const record = value as UnknownObject;
   51: 
   52:     const preferredKeys = [
   53:       "zh-CN",
   54:       "zh",
   55:       "cn",
   56:       "default",
   57:       "en",
   58:       "text",
   59:       "label",
   60:       "title",
   61:       "name",
   62:       "value",
   63:     ];
   64: 
   65:     for (const key of preferredKeys) {
   66:       if (!(key in record)) continue;
   67: 
   68:       const nestedValue = text(record[key]);
   69: 
   70:       if (nestedValue) return nestedValue;
   71:     }
   72:   }
   73: 
   74:   return "";
   75: }
   76: 
   77: function normalize(value: string): string {
   78:   return value
   79:     .toUpperCase()
   80:     .replace(/[‐‑‒–—―﹘﹣－]/g, "-")
   81:     .replace(/\s+/g, "");
   82: }
   83: 
   84: function isNonEmptyString(
   85:   value: string | undefined | null
   86: ): value is string {
   87:   return Boolean(value);
   88: }
   89: 
   90: function firstText(object: UnknownObject, keys: string[]): string {
   91:   for (const key of keys) {
   92:     const value = text(object[key]);
   93:     if (value) return value;
   94:   }
   95: 
   96:   return "";
   97: }

   99: function getFiles(directory: string): string[] {
  100:   if (!fs.existsSync(directory)) return [];
  101: 
  102:   return fs.readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }).flatMap((entry) => {
  103:     const fullPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
  104: 
  105:     if (entry.isDirectory()) {
  106:       return getFiles(fullPath);
  107:     }
  108: 
  109:     if (
  110:       entry.isFile() &&
  111:       !entry.name.includes(".bak") &&
  112:       (
  113:         entry.name.endsWith(".ts") ||
  114:         entry.name.endsWith(".json")
  115:       )
  116:     ) {
  117:       return [fullPath];
  118:     }
  119: 
  120:     return [];
  121:   });
  122: }

  143: function collectProductItems(
  144:   value: unknown,
  145:   sourceFile: string,
  146:   result: SiteSearchItem[],
  147:   seen: WeakSet<object>
  148: ) {
  149:   if (!value || typeof value !== "object") return;
  150: 
  151:   const objectValue = value as object;
  152:   if (seen.has(objectValue)) return;
  153:   seen.add(objectValue);
  154: 
  155:   if (Array.isArray(value)) {
  156:     for (const item of value) {
  157:       collectProductItems(item, sourceFile, result, seen);
  158:     }
  159:     return;
  160:   }
  161: 
  162:   const object = value as UnknownObject;
  163: 
  164:   const href = firstText(object, [
  165:     "detailHref",
  166:     "productHref",
  167:     "href",
  168:     "detailUrl",
  169:     "url",
  170:   ]);
  171: 
  172:   if (isProductHref(href)) {
  173:     const model = firstText(object, [
  174:       "foreachModel",
  175:       "model",
  176:       "modelNumber",
  177:       "slug",
  178:     ]);
  179: 
  180:     const productCode = firstText(object, [
  181:       "productCode",
  182:       "goodsCode",
  183:       "sku",
  184:     ]);
  185: 
  186:     const title =
  187:       firstText(object, [
  188:         "title",
  189:         "productName",
  190:         "name",
  191:         "cardTitle",
  192:       ]) ||
  193:       model ||
  194:       productCode;
  195: 
  196:     const description = firstText(object, [
  197:       "description",
  198:       "summary",
  199:       "subtitle",
  200:       "cardSubtitle",
  201:     ]);
  202: 
  203:     const image = cleanImagePath(
  204:       firstText(object, [
  205:         "imagePath",
  206:         "imageSrc",
  207:         "image",
  208:         "coverImage",
  209:         "mainImage",
  210:       ])
  211:     );
  212: 
  213:     const extraKeywords = firstText(object, [
  214:       "keywords",
  215:       "searchKeywords",
  216:       "tags",
  217:       "categoryLabel",
  218:       "seriesLabel",
  219:       "productType",
  220:       "productSeries",
  221:     ]);
  222: 
  223:     if (title) {
  224:       result.push({
  225:         id: `product:${sourceFile}:${href}:${model || title}`,
  226:         module: "products",
  227:         title,
  228:         subtitle: model && model !== title
  229:           ? `型号：${model}`
  230:           : productCode
  231:             ? `商品编码：${productCode}`
  232:             : "",
  233:         description,
  234:         href,
  235:         image,
  236:         model,
  237:         productCode,
  238:         actionLabel: "查看产品",
  239:         keywords: [
  240:           title,
  241:           model,
  242:           productCode,
  243:           description,
  244:           extraKeywords,
  245:           href,
  246:         ].filter(isNonEmptyString),
  247:       });
  248:     }
  249:   }
  250: 
  251:   for (const child of Object.values(object)) {
  252:     collectProductItems(child, sourceFile, result, seen);
  253:   }
  254: }

  256: async function loadProductItems(): Promise<SiteSearchItem[]> {
  257:   const result: SiteSearchItem[] = [];
  258:   const files = PRODUCT_SEARCH_DIRS.flatMap(getFiles);
  259: 
  260:   for (const file of files) {
  261:     const relativePath = path.relative(ROOT, file).replace(/\\/g, "/");
  262: 
  263:     try {
  264:       if (file.endsWith(".json")) {
  265:         const parsed = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
  266:         collectProductItems(
  267:           parsed,
  268:           relativePath,
  269:           result,
  270:           new WeakSet<object>()
  271:         );
  272:         continue;
  273:       }
  274: 
  275:       const module = await import(
  276:         `${pathToFileURL(file).href}?search=${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`
  277:       );
  278: 
  279:       collectProductItems(
  280:         module,
  281:         relativePath,
  282:         result,
  283:         new WeakSet<object>()
  284:       );
  285:     } catch {
  286:       // 单个历史数据文件不能导入时跳过，不中断全站索引。
  287:     }
  288:   }
  289: 
  290:   return result;
  291: }

  406: function scoreItemQuality(item: SiteSearchItem): number {
  407:   let score = 0;
  408: 
  409:   if (item.href.includes("#")) score -= 5;
  410:   if (item.href.split("/").filter(isNonEmptyString).length >= 4) score += 5;
  411:   if (item.image) score += 2;
  412:   if (item.model) score += 2;
  413:   if (item.productCode) score += 1;
  414: 
  415:   return score;
  416: }
  417: 
  418: function deduplicate(items: SiteSearchItem[]): SiteSearchItem[] {
  419:   const map = new Map<string, SiteSearchItem>();
  420: 
  421:   for (const item of items) {
  422:     const key =
  423:       item.module === "products"
  424:         ? `${item.module}:${item.href}:${normalize(item.model || item.title)}`
  425:         : `${item.module}:${normalize(item.title)}:${item.productCode || item.href}`;
  426: 
  427:     const existing = map.get(key);
  428: 
  429:     if (
  430:       !existing ||
  431:       scoreItemQuality(item) > scoreItemQuality(existing)
  432:     ) {
  433:       map.set(key, item);
  434:     }
  435:   }
  436: 
  437:   return [...map.values()];
  438: }
  439: 
  440: function buildOutput(items: SiteSearchItem[]): string {
  441:   /*
  442:     不直接输出超大的数组字面量。
  443:     否则 TypeScript 会尝试推导数千条记录形成的联合类型，
  444:     并报：union type is too complex to represent。
  445:   */
  446:   const serializedItems = JSON.stringify(items);
  447:   const serializedLiteral = JSON.stringify(serializedItems);
  448: 
  449:   return `/* =========================================================
  450:    site-search-index.generated.ts
  451:    恒永达官网｜全站搜索静态索引
  452: 
  453:    自动生成，请勿手动修改。
  454:    使用 JSON.parse 避免超大数组触发 TypeScript 联合类型推导。
  455: ========================================================= */
  456: 
  457: import type { SiteSearchItem } from "./site-search.types";
  458: 
  459: const siteSearchIndexJson = ${serializedLiteral};
  460: 
  461: export const siteSearchIndex =
  462:   JSON.parse(siteSearchIndexJson) as SiteSearchItem[];
  463: `;
  464: }

    1: const fs = require("fs");
    2: 
    3: const file = "app/products/pumps/diaphragm-pumps/[slug]/page.tsx";
    4: let code = fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8");
    5: 
    6: /*
    7:  * 隔膜泵详情页只保留：
    8:  * - 添加图纸
    9:  * - 加入清单
   10:  * 不显示添加规格书 / 申请3D文件
   11:  */

   13: code = code.replace(/show3DRequest:\s*Boolean\(model3dUrl\),/g, "show3DRequest: false,");

   19:     model3dRequestOnly: false,
   20: 
   21:     showDatasheetRequest: false,
   22:     showDrawingRequest: Boolean(drawing2dUrl),
   23:     show3DRequest: false,`
   24:   );
   25: }
   26: 
   27: fs.writeFileSync(file, code, "utf8");
